model users {
  id            String    @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  email         String    @unique @db.Citext
  username      String    @unique @db.Citext
  display_name  String    @db.VarChar(100)
  password_hash String
  avatar_url    String?
  is_active     Boolean   @default(true)
  last_login_at DateTime? @db.Timestamptz(6)
  created_at    DateTime  @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updated_at    DateTime  @default(now()) @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz(6)

  refresh_tokens      refresh_tokens[]
  owned_workspaces    workspaces[]          @relation("workspace_owner")
  memberships         workspace_members[]
  agents_created      agents[]              @relation("agent_creator")
  projects_created    projects[]            @relation("project_creator")
  assigned_tasks      tasks[]               @relation("task_assignee_user")
  comments            comments[]            @relation("comment_author_user")
  notifications       notifications[]
  dispatched_runs     agent_runs[]          @relation("run_dispatcher")
  web_reports_created web_report_sessions[] @relation("web_report_creator")
  web_reports_updated web_report_sessions[] @relation("web_report_updater")
}

model refresh_tokens {
  id          String    @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  user_id     String    @db.Uuid
  family_id   String    @db.Uuid
  token_hash  String    @unique
  expires_at  DateTime  @db.Timestamptz(6)
  revoked_at  DateTime? @db.Timestamptz(6)
  replaced_by String?   @db.Uuid
  user_agent  String?
  ip_address  String?   @db.Inet
  created_at  DateTime  @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)

  user        users            @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  replacement refresh_tokens?  @relation("token_rotation", fields: [replaced_by], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  replaces    refresh_tokens[] @relation("token_rotation")

  @@index([user_id], map: "refresh_tokens_user_idx")
  @@index([family_id], map: "refresh_tokens_family_idx")
}

model workspaces {
  id         String    @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  name       String    @db.VarChar(100)
  owner_id   String    @db.Uuid
  timezone   String    @default("Asia/Jakarta") @db.VarChar(64)
  created_at DateTime  @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updated_at DateTime  @default(now()) @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz(6)
  deleted_at DateTime? @db.Timestamptz(6)

  owner         users                 @relation("workspace_owner", fields: [owner_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  members       workspace_members[]
  agents        agents[]
  projects      projects[]
  activity_logs activity_logs[]
  notifications notifications[]
  agent_runs    agent_runs[]
  web_reports   web_report_sessions[]
}

model workspace_members {
  workspace_id String         @db.Uuid
  user_id      String         @db.Uuid
  role         workspace_role @default(member)
  created_at   DateTime       @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updated_at   DateTime       @default(now()) @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz(6)

  workspace workspaces @relation(fields: [workspace_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user      users      @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([workspace_id, user_id])
  @@index([user_id], map: "workspace_members_user_idx")
}

model agents {
  id            String    @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  workspace_id  String    @db.Uuid
  name          String    @db.VarChar(100)
  handle        String    @db.Citext
  mcp_agent_key String    @db.VarChar(100)
  description   String?
  avatar_url    String?
  is_active     Boolean   @default(true)
  created_by    String?   @db.Uuid
  created_at    DateTime  @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updated_at    DateTime  @default(now()) @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz(6)
  deleted_at    DateTime? @db.Timestamptz(6)

  workspace      workspaces   @relation(fields: [workspace_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  creator        users?       @relation("agent_creator", fields: [created_by], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  assigned_tasks tasks[]      @relation("task_assignee_agent")
  comments       comments[]   @relation("comment_author_agent")
  agent_runs     agent_runs[]
}

model projects {
  id           String    @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  workspace_id String    @db.Uuid
  title        String    @db.VarChar(200)
  description  String?
  icon         String?   @db.VarChar(16)
  created_by   String?   @db.Uuid
  created_at   DateTime  @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updated_at   DateTime  @default(now()) @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz(6)
  deleted_at   DateTime? @db.Timestamptz(6)

  workspace     workspaces        @relation(fields: [workspace_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  creator       users?            @relation("project_creator", fields: [created_by], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  tasks         tasks[]
  blocks        document_blocks[]
  comments      comments[]
  activity_logs activity_logs[]
  notifications notifications[]
  agent_runs    agent_runs[]
}

model tasks {
  id                String            @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  project_id        String            @db.Uuid
  parent_task_id    String?           @db.Uuid
  depth             Int               @default(1) @db.SmallInt
  title             String            @db.VarChar(500)
  status            task_status       @default(todo)
  priority          task_priority     @default(none)
  assignee_type     actor_type?
  assignee_user_id  String?           @db.Uuid
  assignee_agent_id String?           @db.Uuid
  start_date        DateTime?         @db.Date
  end_date          DateTime?         @db.Date
  is_milestone      Boolean           @default(false)
  tags              String[]          @default([])
  order_index       Int               @default(0)
  agent_status      agent_work_status @default(idle)
  created_by_type   actor_type        @default(user)
  created_by_id     String?           @db.Uuid
  completed_at      DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz(6)
  created_at        DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updated_at        DateTime          @default(now()) @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz(6)
  deleted_at        DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz(6)

  project        projects          @relation(fields: [project_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  parent         tasks?            @relation("task_tree", fields: [parent_task_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  children       tasks[]           @relation("task_tree")
  assignee_user  users?            @relation("task_assignee_user", fields: [assignee_user_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  assignee_agent agents?           @relation("task_assignee_agent", fields: [assignee_agent_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  blocks         document_blocks[]
  agent_runs     agent_runs[]

  @@index([project_id, status, order_index], map: "tasks_project_idx")
  @@index([parent_task_id], map: "tasks_parent_idx")
  @@index([project_id, start_date], map: "tasks_timeline_idx")
  @@index([assignee_user_id], map: "tasks_assignee_user_idx")
  @@index([assignee_agent_id], map: "tasks_assignee_agent_idx")
  @@index([tags], map: "tasks_tags_idx", type: Gin)
}

model document_blocks {
  id                  String     @id @db.Uuid
  project_id          String     @db.Uuid
  task_id             String?    @db.Uuid
  parent_block_id     String?    @db.Uuid
  block_type          String     @db.VarChar(32)
  content_json        Json       @default("{}")
  plain_text          String     @default("")
  order_index         Int
  version             Int        @default(1)
  last_edited_by_type actor_type @default(user)
  last_edited_by_id   String?    @db.Uuid
  created_at          DateTime   @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updated_at          DateTime   @default(now()) @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz(6)
  deleted_at          DateTime?  @db.Timestamptz(6)
  // search_vector tsvector GENERATED (dibuat di migrasi SQL, tidak dimodelkan)

  project  projects          @relation(fields: [project_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  task     tasks?            @relation(fields: [task_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  parent   document_blocks?  @relation("block_tree", fields: [parent_block_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  children document_blocks[] @relation("block_tree")
}

model comments {
  id                String      @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  project_id        String      @db.Uuid
  entity_type       entity_type
  entity_id         String      @db.Uuid
  parent_comment_id String?     @db.Uuid
  author_type       actor_type
  author_user_id    String?     @db.Uuid
  author_agent_id   String?     @db.Uuid
  content           String
  mentions          Json        @default("[]")
  edited_at         DateTime?   @db.Timestamptz(6)
  created_at        DateTime    @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updated_at        DateTime    @default(now()) @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz(6)
  deleted_at        DateTime?   @db.Timestamptz(6)

  project      projects   @relation(fields: [project_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  parent       comments?  @relation("comment_thread", fields: [parent_comment_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  replies      comments[] @relation("comment_thread")
  author_user  users?     @relation("comment_author_user", fields: [author_user_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  author_agent agents?    @relation("comment_author_agent", fields: [author_agent_id], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
}

model activity_logs {
  id            String      @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  workspace_id  String      @db.Uuid
  project_id    String?     @db.Uuid
  entity_type   entity_type
  entity_id     String      @db.Uuid
  action        String      @db.VarChar(64)

  @@index([project_id, created_at(sort: Desc)], map: "activity_project_idx")
  @@index([entity_type, entity_id, created_at(sort: Desc)], map: "activity_entity_idx")

model notifications {

"""Alembic env (async). Hanya mengelola objek di schema `mcp`; schema `public` milik Prisma."""

import asyncio
from typing import Any

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import pool, text
from sqlalchemy.engine import Connection
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine

from mcp_marketing.models import Base

config = context.config
target_metadata = Base.metadata
SCHEMA = "mcp"


def _url() -> str:
    # urutan: Config.attributes["url"] (test/manage.py) -> -x url=... -> MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL
    url = config.attributes.get("url") or context.get_x_argument(as_dictionary=True).get("url")
    if url:
        return str(url)
    from mcp_marketing.core.config import get_settings

    return get_settings().db.migration_database_url


def include_object(obj: Any, name: str | None, type_: str, reflected: bool, compare_to: Any) -> bool:
    # tabel public (Prisma) tidak pernah di-autogenerate atau di-drop
    if type_ == "table":
        return getattr(obj, "schema", None) == SCHEMA
    table = getattr(obj, "table", None)
    return table is None or getattr(table, "schema", None) == SCHEMA


def _configure(connection: Connection | None = None, **kw: Any) -> None:
    context.configure(
        connection=connection,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        version_table_schema=SCHEMA,
        include_schemas=True,
        include_object=include_object,

def pytest_collection_modifyitems(config: pytest.Config, items: list[pytest.Item]) -> None:
    for item in items:
        if "integration" in str(item.fspath):
            item.add_marker(pytest.mark.integration)
            if not ADMIN_URL:
                item.add_marker(pytest.mark.skip(reason="TEST_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL tidak diset"))


def _with(url: str, *, user: str | None = None, password: str | None = None, db: str | None = None,
          driver: str = "postgresql") -> str:
    parts = urlsplit(url.replace("postgresql+asyncpg://", "postgresql://", 1))
    host = parts.hostname or "127.0.0.1"
    port = parts.port or 5432
    u = user or parts.username or "postgres"
    p = password if password is not None else (parts.password or "")
    netloc = f"{u}:{p}@{host}:{port}"
    path = f"/{db}" if db else parts.path
    return urlunsplit((driver, netloc, path, "", ""))


def owner_url() -> str:

async def _apply_public_schema(conn: asyncpg.Connection) -> None:
    files = sorted(DASHBOARD_MIGRATIONS.glob("*/migration.sql")) if DASHBOARD_MIGRATIONS.exists() else []
    if not files:
        await conn.execute(MINIMAL_PUBLIC_SCHEMA)
        return
    for path in files:
        await conn.execute(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def _psql() -> str:
    found = shutil.which("psql")
    return found or str(PSQL_DEFAULT)


def _run_bootstrap() -> None:
    parts = urlsplit(admin_test_url())
    env = {**os.environ, "PGPASSWORD": parts.password or ""}
    cmd = [
        _psql(), "-h", parts.hostname or "127.0.0.1", "-p", str(parts.port or 5432),
        "-U", parts.username or "postgres", "-d", TEST_DB, "-q",
        "-v", f"owner_role={OWNER}", "-v", f"app_role={APP}",
        "-v", f"owner_pw={OWNER_PW}", "-v", f"app_pw={APP_PW}",
        "-f", str(PROJECT_ROOT / "scripts" / "sql" / "bootstrap.sql"),

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from mcp_marketing.models import AgentProfile
from mcp_marketing.services.llm import prompts

PROMPT_VERSION = "v1"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProfileSeed:
    agent_key: str
    display_name: str
    route: str
    toolsets: tuple[str, ...]
    run_token_budget: int
    max_steps: int = 25
    tool_denylist: tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)

    def system_prompt(self) -> str:
        role = prompts.load(f"agent_{self.agent_key}", PROMPT_VERSION)
        rules = prompts.load("agent_rules", PROMPT_VERSION)
        return f"{role}\n\n{rules}"

        display_name="Agent Strategist",
        route="smart",
        toolsets=("pm_agent", "tpl", "task", "kb", "analysis", "data"),
        run_token_budget=120_000,
        tool_denylist=("sentiment_analyze", "sentiment_summary", "market_analyze"),
    ),
    ProfileSeed(
        agent_key="researcher",
        display_name="Agent Researcher",
        route="smart",
        toolsets=("pm_agent", "web", "social", "trends", "kb", "analysis", "data", "job"),
        run_token_budget=150_000,
        tool_denylist=("campaign_analyze", "dm_strategy"),

    ProfileSeed(

        route="smart",
        toolsets=("pm_agent", "db", "data", "analysis", "kb", "job"),
        run_token_budget=100_000,
    ),
)


async def get_active_profile(session: AsyncSession, agent_key: str) -> AgentProfile | None:
    row = await session.scalar(
        select(AgentProfile).where(
            AgentProfile.agent_key == agent_key, AgentProfile.is_active.is_(True)
        )
    )
    return row

"""CLI operasional MCP Marketing.

    python scripts/manage.py migrate [--target head]
    python scripts/manage.py seed [--force]
    python scripts/manage.py db-check
    python scripts/manage.py create-client --name claude-desktop --toolsets toolbox,data,job,trends
    python scripts/manage.py list-clients
    python scripts/manage.py revoke-client <id|name>
    python scripts/manage.py rotate-client <id|name>
    python scripts/manage.py job-retry <job_id>
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import sys
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

import asyncpg  # noqa: E402
from sqlalchemy import text  # noqa: E402

from mcp_marketing.core.config import get_settings  # noqa: E402
from mcp_marketing.core.database import Database, asyncpg_dsn  # noqa: E402


async def _vector_installed(url: str) -> bool:
    conn = await asyncpg.connect(asyncpg_dsn(url))
    try:
        return bool(await conn.fetchval("SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'vector'"))
    finally:
        await conn.close()


def cmd_migrate(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    from alembic import command
    from alembic.config import Config

    url = get_settings().db.migration_database_url

"""TASK-03: migrasi, grant least-privilege, model read-only, seed idempoten."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import uuid

import asyncpg
import pytest
from alembic import command
from sqlalchemy import func, select

from mcp_marketing.core.database import Database
from mcp_marketing.models import AgentProfile, ApiClient, Schedule
from mcp_marketing.models.dashboard import Task
from mcp_marketing.services.seed import seed
from tests.integration.conftest import (
    admin_test_url,
    alembic_config,
    app_url,
    migrate_target,
    owner_url,
)

PUBLIC_CHECKSUM_SQL = """
SELECT md5(string_agg(table_name || '.' || column_name || ':' || data_type, ',' ORDER BY table_name, column_name))
FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public'
"""


async def _admin() -> asyncpg.Connection:
    return await asyncpg.connect(admin_test_url())


async def test_upgrade_downgrade_upgrade_keeps_public_untouched(db: Database) -> None:
    conn = await _admin()
    try:
        before = await conn.fetchval(PUBLIC_CHECKSUM_SQL)
        cfg = alembic_config(owner_url())
        target = await migrate_target()
        await asyncio.to_thread(command.downgrade, cfg, "base")
        assert await conn.fetchval("SELECT count(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='mcp' AND tablename <> 'alembic_version'") == 0
        await asyncio.to_thread(command.upgrade, cfg, target)
        await asyncio.to_thread(command.downgrade, cfg, "-1")
        await asyncio.to_thread(command.upgrade, cfg, target)
        after = await conn.fetchval(PUBLIC_CHECKSUM_SQL)
        tables = await conn.fetchval("SELECT count(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='mcp'")
    finally:
        await conn.close()
    assert before == after
    assert tables >= 28


async def _app_conn() -> asyncpg.Connection:
    return await asyncpg.connect(app_url().replace("postgresql+asyncpg://", "postgresql://"))


async def test_grants_least_privilege(db: Database) -> None:
    conn = await _app_conn()
    try:
        with pytest.raises(asyncpg.InsufficientPrivilegeError):
            await conn.fetch("SELECT email FROM public.users")
        with pytest.raises(asyncpg.InsufficientPrivilegeError):
            await conn.fetch("SELECT password_hash FROM public.users")
        with pytest.raises(asyncpg.InsufficientPrivilegeError):
            await conn.fetch("SELECT * FROM public.refresh_tokens")
        await conn.fetch("SELECT display_name FROM public.users")
        with pytest.raises(asyncpg.InsufficientPrivilegeError):
            await conn.execute("INSERT INTO public.tasks (id) VALUES (gen_random_uuid())")
        await conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO mcp.schedules (name, cron, job_kind) VALUES ('grant-test', '* * * * *', 'x')"
        )
        await conn.execute("DELETE FROM mcp.schedules WHERE name = 'grant-test'")
    finally:
        await conn.close()


async def test_readonly_model_flush_rejected(db: Database) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="read-only"):
        async with db.session() as session:
            session.add(Task(id=uuid.uuid4(), project_id=uuid.uuid4(), depth=1, title="x",
                             status="todo", priority="none", is_milestone=False, tags=[],
                             agent_status="idle"))
            await session.flush()


async def test_seed_idempotent(clean_db: Database) -> None:
    async with clean_db.session() as s:
        first = await seed(s)
    async with clean_db.session() as s:
        second = await seed(s)
    assert first == {"agent_profiles": 3, "clients": 1, "schedules": 3}
    assert second == {"agent_profiles": 0, "clients": 0, "schedules": 0}
    async with clean_db.session() as s:
        assert await s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(AgentProfile)) == 3
        assert await s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(Schedule)) == 3
        dash = await s.scalar(select(ApiClient).where(ApiClient.name == "dashboard"))
        assert dash is not None and dash.kind == "system" and dash.toolsets == ["pm"]


async def test_seed_force_updates_profiles(clean_db: Database) -> None:
    async with clean_db.session() as s:
        await seed(s)
    async with clean_db.session() as s:
        await seed(s, force=True)
    async with clean_db.session() as s:
        prof = await s.scalar(select(AgentProfile).where(AgentProfile.agent_key == "strategist"))
    assert prof is not None and prof.version == 2
    assert "finish" in prof.system_prompt


async def test_health_reports_vector_flag(db: Database) -> None:
    health = await db.health()
    assert health["db"] is True
    assert isinstance(health["vector"], bool)

"""Alembic env (async). Hanya mengelola objek di schema `mcp`; schema `public` milik Prisma."""

import asyncio
from typing import Any

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import pool, text
from sqlalchemy.engine import Connection
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine

from mcp_marketing.models import Base

config = context.config
target_metadata = Base.metadata
SCHEMA = "mcp"


def _url() -> str:
    # urutan: Config.attributes["url"] (test/manage.py) -> -x url=... -> MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL
    url = config.attributes.get("url") or context.get_x_argument(as_dictionary=True).get("url")
    if url:
        return str(url)
    from mcp_marketing.core.config import get_settings

    return get_settings().db.migration_database_url


def include_object(obj: Any, name: str | None, type_: str, reflected: bool, compare_to: Any) -> bool:
    # tabel public (Prisma) tidak pernah di-autogenerate atau di-drop
    if type_ == "table":
        return getattr(obj, "schema", None) == SCHEMA
    table = getattr(obj, "table", None)
    return table is None or getattr(table, "schema", None) == SCHEMA


def _configure(connection: Connection | None = None, **kw: Any) -> None:
    context.configure(
        connection=connection,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        version_table_schema=SCHEMA,
        include_schemas=True,
        include_object=include_object,
        transaction_per_migration=True,
        compare_type=True,
        **kw,
    )


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    _configure(url=_url(), literal_binds=True, dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"})
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def _do_run(connection: Connection) -> None:
    exists = connection.execute(
        text("SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = :s"), {"s": SCHEMA}
    ).scalar()
    if not exists:
        connection.execute(text(f"CREATE SCHEMA {SCHEMA}"))
        connection.commit()
    _configure(connection)
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


async def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    engine = create_async_engine(_url(), poolclass=pool.NullPool)
    async with engine.connect() as connection:
        await connection.run_sync(_do_run)
    await engine.dispose()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    asyncio.run(run_migrations_online())

"""Schema I/O bersama semua tool (MCP_SPEC §2): parameter umum, envelope, job, error."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

ResponseFormat = Literal["concise", "detailed"]
CacheMode = Literal["use", "bypass"]


class ToolInput(BaseModel):
    """Input tool: field tak dikenal ditolak agar LLM cepat tahu salah nama parameter."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


class ReadInput(ToolInput):
    response_format: ResponseFormat = Field(
        default="concise", description="concise = ringkas (maks 5 contoh); detailed = hingga 20 item"
    )
    cache: CacheMode = Field(default="use", description="bypass untuk memaksa hitung ulang")


class Table(BaseModel):
    """Format kolom-baris (hemat token dibanding list objek)."""

    cols: list[str]
    rows: list[list[Any]]


class Cost(BaseModel):
    llm_tokens: int = 0
    external_units: int = 0
    cache_hit: bool = False

"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any

import orjson
from sqlalchemy import delete, text
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import insert

from mcp_marketing.core.database import Database
from mcp_marketing.models import CacheEntry
from mcp_marketing.utils.crypto import sha256_hex
from mcp_marketing.utils.time import now

EXCLUDED_ARGS = frozenset({"response_format", "cache"})


def canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:
    return orjson.dumps(value, option=orjson.OPT_SORT_KEYS, default=str).decode()


def tool_cache_key(tool: str, version: int, args: dict[str, Any], workspace_id: str | None) -> str:
    material = {k: v for k, v in args.items() if k not in EXCLUDED_ARGS}
    return sha256_hex(f"{tool}|{version}|{canonical_json(material)}|{workspace_id or '-'}")


def llm_cache_key(route: str, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], params: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return sha256_hex(f"{route}|{canonical_json(messages)}|{canonical_json(params)}")


class ResultCache:
    def __init__(self, db: Database) -> None:
        self.db = db

    async def get(self, key: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            row = (
                await session.execute(
                    text(
                        "UPDATE mcp.cache_entries SET hits = hits + 1 "
                        "WHERE cache_key = :k AND expires_at > now() RETURNING value"
                    ),
                    {"k": key},
                )
            ).first()
        return dict(row[0]) if row else None

    async def set(self, key: str, namespace: str, value: dict[str, Any], ttl_s: int) -> None:
        if ttl_s <= 0:
            return
        payload = orjson.loads(orjson.dumps(value, default=str))
        size = len(orjson.dumps(payload))
        expires = now() + timedelta(seconds=ttl_s)
        stmt = insert(CacheEntry).values(
            cache_key=key, namespace=namespace, value=payload, size_bytes=size, expires_at=expires
        )
        stmt = stmt.on_conflict_do_update(
            index_elements=["cache_key"],
            set_={"value": payload, "size_bytes": size, "expires_at": expires, "hits": 0},
        )
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            await session.execute(stmt)

    async def purge_expired(self) -> int:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            result = await session.execute(delete(CacheEntry).where(CacheEntry.expires_at <= now()))
        return int(result.rowcount or 0)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

"""Budget token LLM tiga lapis (per tool call, per run, per klien per hari) + kuota unit eksternal.

Pola pakai: `res = await scope.reserve(estimate)` SEBELUM panggilan LLM -> panggil ->
`await scope.commit(res, actual)` (atau `release(res)` bila gagal). Melebihi batas ->
`BUDGET_EXCEEDED` sebelum token terbuang (MCP_SPEC §3 T8).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date
from typing import Any

from mcp_marketing.core.errors import BudgetExceeded
from mcp_marketing.core.logging import get_logger
from mcp_marketing.utils.time import now

log = get_logger(__name__)

Loader = Callable[[], Awaitable[int]]
Persister = Callable[[int], Awaitable[None]]


class BudgetLayer:
    """Satu lapis budget dengan lock agar reserve paralel tidak melampaui batas."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        scope: str,
        limit: int | None,
        used: int = 0,
        persist: Persister | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.scope = scope
        self.limit = limit
        self.used = used
        self.reserved = 0
        self._persist = persist
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    @property
    def remaining(self) -> int | None:
        return None if self.limit is None else max(0, self.limit - self.used - self.reserved)

    async def reserve(self, amount: int) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            if self.limit is not None and self.used + self.reserved + amount > self.limit:
                raise BudgetExceeded(
                    f"Budget token {self.scope} tidak cukup",
                    details={
                        "used": self.used,
                        "reserved": self.reserved,
                        "requested": amount,
                        "limit": self.limit,
                        "scope": self.scope,
                    },
                )
            self.reserved += amount

    async def settle(self, reserved: int, actual: int) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            self.reserved = max(0, self.reserved - reserved)
            self.used += actual
            used = self.used
        if self._persist is not None and actual:
            try:
                await self._persist(used)
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - kegagalan persist tidak boleh menggagalkan tool
                log.warning("budget.persist_failed", scope=self.scope, error=str(exc))


@dataclass
class Reservation:
    amount: int
    layers: list[BudgetLayer]
    settled: bool = False


@dataclass
class BudgetScope:
    """Gabungan lapis yang berlaku untuk satu tool call / satu langkah agent."""

    layers: list[BudgetLayer] = field(default_factory=list)
    used: int = 0

    async def reserve(self, amount: int) -> Reservation:
        done: list[BudgetLayer] = []
        try:
            for layer in self.layers:
                await layer.reserve(amount)
                done.append(layer)
        except BudgetExceeded:
            for layer in done:
                await layer.settle(amount, 0)
            raise
        return Reservation(amount=amount, layers=done)

    async def commit(self, reservation: Reservation, actual: int) -> None:
        if reservation.settled:
            return
        reservation.settled = True
        self.used += actual
        for layer in reservation.layers:
            await layer.settle(reservation.amount, actual)

    async def release(self, reservation: Reservation) -> None:
        await self.commit(reservation, 0)

    def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {layer.scope: {"used": layer.used, "limit": layer.limit} for layer in self.layers}


class ExternalQuota:
    """Kuota unit eksternal harian (mis. post X yang dibaca, X_MAX_READS_PER_DAY)."""

    def __init__(self, kind: str, per_day: int) -> None:
        self.kind = kind
        self.per_day = per_day
        self._day: date | None = None
        self._used = 0
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def reserve(self, units: int) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            today = now().date()
            if today != self._day:
                self._day, self._used = today, 0
            if self._used + units > self.per_day:
                raise BudgetExceeded(
                    f"Kuota harian {self.kind} habis",
                    details={"used": self._used, "requested": units, "limit": self.per_day,
                             "scope": f"external:{self.kind}"},
                )
            self._used += units


class BudgetManager:
    """Menyimpan lapis budget klien (per hari) dan run agar dipakai bersama antar panggilan."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        client_used_loader: Callable[[str, date], Awaitable[int]] | None = None,
        run_loader: Callable[[str], Awaitable[tuple[int, int] | None]] | None = None,
        run_persister: Callable[[str, int], Awaitable[None]] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._client_layers: dict[tuple[str, date], BudgetLayer] = {}
        self._run_layers: dict[str, BudgetLayer] = {}
        self._client_used_loader = client_used_loader
        self._run_loader = run_loader
        self._run_persister = run_persister
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.external: dict[str, ExternalQuota] = {}

    async def client_layer(self, client_id: str, daily_limit: int | None) -> BudgetLayer | None:
        if daily_limit is None:
            return None
        key = (client_id, now().date())
        async with self._lock:
            layer = self._client_layers.get(key)
            if layer is None:
                used = await self._client_used_loader(client_id, key[1]) if self._client_used_loader else 0
                # buang lapis hari sebelumnya
                self._client_layers = {k: v for k, v in self._client_layers.items() if k[1] == key[1]}
                layer = BudgetLayer(f"client_daily:{client_id}", daily_limit, used)
                self._client_layers[key] = layer
            layer.limit = daily_limit
        return layer

    async def run_layer(self, run_id: str) -> BudgetLayer | None:
        async with self._lock:
            layer = self._run_layers.get(run_id)
            if layer is None and self._run_loader is not None:
                loaded = await self._run_loader(run_id)
                if loaded is None:
                    return None
                used, limit = loaded

                async def persist(value: int, _rid: str = run_id) -> None:
                    if self._run_persister is not None:
                        await self._run_persister(_rid, value)

                layer = BudgetLayer("run", limit, used, persist)
                self._run_layers[run_id] = layer
        return layer

    def forget_run(self, run_id: str) -> None:
        self._run_layers.pop(run_id, None)

    async def scope(
        self,
        *,
        client_id: str | None,
        daily_limit: int | None,
        run_id: str | None,
        tool_limit: int | None,
    ) -> BudgetScope:
        layers: list[BudgetLayer] = []
        if tool_limit is not None:
            layers.append(BudgetLayer("tool_call", tool_limit))
        if run_id:
            run_layer = await self.run_layer(run_id)
            if run_layer is not None:
                layers.append(run_layer)
        if client_id:
            client_layer = await self.client_layer(client_id, daily_limit)
            if client_layer is not None:
                layers.append(client_layer)
        return BudgetScope(layers=layers)

    def external_quota(self, kind: str, per_day: int) -> ExternalQuota:
        quota = self.external.get(kind)
        if quota is None or quota.per_day != per_day:
            quota = ExternalQuota(kind, per_day)
            self.external[kind] = quota
        return quota

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date
from typing import Any

class BudgetLayer:
    """Satu lapis budget dengan lock agar reserve paralel tidak melampaui batas."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        scope: str,
        limit: int | None,
        used: int = 0,
        persist: Persister | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.scope = scope
        self.limit = limit
        self.used = used
        self.reserved = 0
        self._persist = persist
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    @property
    def remaining(self) -> int | None:
        return None if self.limit is None else max(0, self.limit - self.used - self.reserved)

    async def reserve(self, amount: int) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            if self.limit is not None and self.used + self.reserved + amount > self.limit:
                raise BudgetExceeded(
                    f"Budget token {self.scope} tidak cukup",
                    details={
                        "used": self.used,
                        "reserved": self.reserved,
                        "requested": amount,
                        "limit": self.limit,
                        "scope": self.scope,
                    },
                )
            self.reserved += amount

    async def settle(self, reserved: int, actual: int) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            self.reserved = max(0, self.reserved - reserved)
            self.used += actual
            used = self.used
        if self._persist is not None and actual:
            try:
                await self._persist(used)
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - kegagalan persist tidak boleh menggagalkan tool
                log.warning("budget.persist_failed", scope=self.scope, error=str(exc))

"""Result store: data besar disimpan sebagai handle (`h_…`) dan dibaca bertahap (MCP_SPEC §3 T2–T4).

Baris disimpan di `mcp.result_items.data` (jsonb, kolom terproyeksi). Paginasi keyset
`(data->'col', idx)` dengan cursor base64; agregasi dilakukan di SQL.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import csv
import io
import uuid
from collections.abc import Iterable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal

import orjson
from sqlalchemy import insert, select, text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from mcp_marketing.core.database import Database
from mcp_marketing.core.errors import NotFound, ValidationFailed
from mcp_marketing.models import ResultItem, ResultSet
from mcp_marketing.utils.ids import new_handle
from mcp_marketing.utils.text import truncate
from mcp_marketing.utils.time import now

BATCH = 1_000
FILTER_OPS = frozenset(
    {"eq", "ne", "lt", "lte", "gt", "gte", "in", "contains", "icontains", "starts_with",
     "is_null", "between"}
)
TIME_BUCKETS = ("hour", "day", "week", "month")
SIMPLE_METRICS = ("sum", "avg", "min", "max", "p50", "p90")
MAX_GROUP_BY = 3


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Owner:
    client_id: str | None
    run_id: str | None = None
    is_admin: bool = False


def _json_safe(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, uuid.UUID):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, list | tuple):
        return [_json_safe(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: _json_safe(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    return value


def _to_ts(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str) and value:
        try:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        except ValueError:
            return None
    return None


def _to_num(value: Any) -> float | None:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return float(value)
    if isinstance(value, int | float):
        return float(value)
    return None


def encode_cursor(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(orjson.dumps(payload)).decode().rstrip("=")


def decode_cursor(cursor: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        padded = cursor + "=" * (-len(cursor) % 4)
        data = orjson.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(padded))
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise ValueError
        return data
    except ValueError:
        raise ValidationFailed("cursor tidak valid", details={"field": "cursor"}) from None


class ResultStore:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, *, ttl_days: int = 30, timezone: str = "Asia/Jakarta",
                 export_dir: Path | None = None) -> None:
        self.db = db
        self.ttl_days = ttl_days
        self.timezone = timezone
        self.export_dir = export_dir

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ create
    async def create(
        self,
        *,
        kind: str,
        columns: list[str],
        rows: Iterable[dict[str, Any]],
        stats: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        source_ref: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        owner: Owner,
        job_id: str | None = None,
        sort_ts: str | None = None,
        sort_num: str | None = None,
        ref_id: str | None = None,
        ttl_days: int | None = None,
    ) -> ResultSet:
        handle = new_handle()
        expires = now() + timedelta(days=ttl_days or self.ttl_days)
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            rs = ResultSet(
                handle=handle,
                kind=kind,
                client_id=uuid.UUID(owner.client_id) if owner.client_id else None,
                run_id=uuid.UUID(owner.run_id) if owner.run_id else None,
                job_id=job_id,
                columns=list(columns),
                total=0,
                stats=_json_safe(stats or {}),
                source_ref=_json_safe(source_ref or {}),
                expires_at=expires,
            )
            session.add(rs)
            await session.flush()
            total = 0
            batch: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for row in rows:
                batch.append(
                    {
                        "handle": handle,
                        "idx": total,
                        "ref_id": row.get(ref_id) if ref_id else None,
                        "data": _json_safe({c: row.get(c) for c in columns}),
                        "sort_ts": _to_ts(row.get(sort_ts)) if sort_ts else None,
                        "sort_num": _to_num(row.get(sort_num)) if sort_num else None,
                    }
                )
                total += 1
                if len(batch) >= BATCH:
                    await session.execute(insert(ResultItem), batch)
                    batch = []
            if batch:
                await session.execute(insert(ResultItem), batch)
            rs.total = total
        return rs

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ read
    async def get_set(self, session: AsyncSession, handle: str, owner: Owner) -> ResultSet:
        rs = await session.get(ResultSet, handle)
        if rs is None or rs.expires_at <= now() or not self._can_read(rs, owner):
            # tidak membedakan "tidak ada" dan "bukan milikmu" agar handle tidak bisa ditebak
            raise NotFound(f"Handle {handle} tidak ditemukan atau kedaluwarsa")
        return rs

    @staticmethod
    def _can_read(rs: ResultSet, owner: Owner) -> bool:
        if owner.is_admin:
            return True
        if owner.client_id and rs.client_id and str(rs.client_id) == owner.client_id:
            return True
        return bool(owner.run_id and rs.run_id and str(rs.run_id) == owner.run_id)

    @staticmethod
    def _check_fields(fields: Iterable[str], columns: list[str], param: str) -> None:
        unknown = [f for f in fields if f not in columns]
        if unknown:
            raise ValidationFailed(
                f"{param} tidak dikenal: {', '.join(unknown)}",
                details={"field": param, "allowed": columns},
            )

    def _filter_sql(
        self, flt: dict[str, Any], columns: list[str], params: dict[str, Any]
    ) -> list[str]:
        self._check_fields(flt.keys(), columns, "filter")
        clauses: list[str] = []
        for i, (field, cond) in enumerate(flt.items()):
            if not isinstance(cond, dict):
                cond = {"op": "eq", "value": cond}
            op = cond.get("op", "eq")
            value = cond.get("value")
            if op not in FILTER_OPS:
                raise ValidationFailed(f"operator filter tidak dikenal: {op}", details={"field": "filter"})
            fk, pk = f"f{i}", f"v{i}"
            params[fk] = field
            txt = f"(data->>:{fk})"
            num = f"(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(data->:{fk}) = 'number' THEN (data->>:{fk})::numeric END)"
            numeric = isinstance(value, int | float) and not isinstance(value, bool)
            col = num if numeric else txt
            sql_ops = {"eq": "=", "ne": "<>", "lt": "<", "lte": "<=", "gt": ">", "gte": ">="}
            if op in sql_ops:
                params[pk] = value if numeric else (None if value is None else str(value).lower()
                                                    if isinstance(value, bool) else str(value))
                clauses.append(f"{col} {sql_ops[op]} :{pk}")
            elif op == "in":
                if not isinstance(value, list) or not value:
                    raise ValidationFailed("filter 'in' butuh list", details={"field": "filter"})
                params[pk] = [str(v) for v in value]
                clauses.append(f"{txt} = ANY(:{pk})")
            elif op in ("contains", "icontains", "starts_with"):
                params[pk] = str(value)
                like = "ILIKE" if op == "icontains" else "LIKE"
                pattern = f"'%' || :{pk} || '%'" if op != "starts_with" else f":{pk} || '%'"
                # untuk array (mis. hashtags) contains = elemen ada di array
                clauses.append(
                    f"(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(data->:{fk}) = 'array' "
                    f"THEN (data->:{fk}) ? :{pk} ELSE {txt} {like} {pattern} END)"
                )
            elif op == "is_null":
                clauses.append(f"(data->:{fk} IS NULL OR data->:{fk} = 'null'::jsonb)"
                               if value in (None, True) else
                               f"(data->:{fk} IS NOT NULL AND data->:{fk} <> 'null'::jsonb)")
            elif op == "between":
                if not isinstance(value, list) or len(value) != 2:
                    raise ValidationFailed("filter 'between' butuh [a, b]", details={"field": "filter"})
                lo, hi = value
                both_num = all(isinstance(v, int | float) and not isinstance(v, bool) for v in value)
                c = num if both_num else txt
                params[f"{pk}a"], params[f"{pk}b"] = (lo, hi) if both_num else (str(lo), str(hi))
                clauses.append(f"{c} BETWEEN :{pk}a AND :{pk}b")
        return clauses

    async def page(
        self,
        handle: str,
        owner: Owner,
        *,
        fields: list[str] | None = None,
        flt: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        order_by: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 10,
        cursor: str | None = None,
        text_max_chars: int = 280,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            rs = await self.get_set(session, handle, owner)
            columns = list(rs.columns)
            cols = fields or columns
            self._check_fields(cols, columns, "fields")
            params: dict[str, Any] = {"h": handle, "lim": limit + 1}
            where = ["handle = :h"]
            where += self._filter_sql(flt or {}, columns, params)
            desc = bool(order_by and order_by.startswith("-"))
            key_col = order_by.lstrip("-+") if order_by else None
            if key_col:
                self._check_fields([key_col], columns, "order_by")
                params["ok"] = key_col
                key_expr = "COALESCE(data->:ok, 'null'::jsonb)"
            else:
                key_expr = "to_jsonb(idx)"
            if cursor:
                cur = decode_cursor(cursor)
                if cur.get("o") != (order_by or ""):
                    raise ValidationFailed("cursor milik urutan lain", details={"field": "cursor"})
                params["ck"] = orjson.dumps(cur.get("k")).decode()
                params["ci"] = int(cur.get("i", -1))
                cmp = "<" if desc else ">"
                where.append(f"({key_expr}, idx) {cmp} (CAST(:ck AS jsonb), :ci)")
            direction = "DESC" if desc else "ASC"
            sql = (
                f"SELECT idx, data, {key_expr} AS k FROM mcp.result_items "
                f"WHERE {' AND '.join(where)} ORDER BY {key_expr} {direction}, idx {direction} "
                "LIMIT :lim"
            )
            rows = (await session.execute(text(sql), params)).all()
            filtered_total = rs.total
            if flt:
                count_sql = f"SELECT count(*) FROM mcp.result_items WHERE {' AND '.join(where[: 1 + len(flt)])}"
                count_params = {k: v for k, v in params.items() if k not in ("ck", "ci", "lim")}
                filtered_total = int((await session.execute(text(count_sql), count_params)).scalar() or 0)
        has_more = len(rows) > limit
        rows = rows[:limit]
        next_cursor = (
            encode_cursor({"o": order_by or "", "k": rows[-1].k, "i": rows[-1].idx})
            if has_more and rows else None
        )
        table_rows = [

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ aggregate
    def _group_expr(self, g: str, columns: list[str], time_bucket: str | None, i: int,
                    params: dict[str, Any]) -> str:

            bucket = time_bucket or (g if g in TIME_BUCKETS else "day")
            params["tz"] = self.timezone
            return f"to_char(date_trunc('{bucket}', sort_ts AT TIME ZONE :tz), 'YYYY-MM-DD\"T\"HH24:MI')"
        self._check_fields([g], columns, "group_by")
        params[f"g{i}"] = g
        if time_bucket:
            # kolom waktu eksplisit dikelompokkan per bucket bila berisi timestamp
            params["tz"] = self.timezone
            return (
                f"(CASE WHEN (data->>:g{i}) ~ '^\\d{{4}}-\\d{{2}}-\\d{{2}}' THEN to_char(date_trunc("
                f"'{time_bucket}', ((data->>:g{i})::timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE :tz), "
                f"'YYYY-MM-DD\"T\"HH24:MI') ELSE data->>:g{i} END)"
            )

            q = 0.5 if kind == "p50" else 0.9

    async def aggregate(
        self,
        handle: str,
        owner: Owner,
        *,
        group_by: list[str],
        metrics: list[str],
        time_bucket: Literal["hour", "day", "week", "month"] | None = None,
        limit: int = 50,

    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if len(group_by) > MAX_GROUP_BY:
            raise ValidationFailed("group_by maksimal 3", details={"field": "group_by"})
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            rs = await self.get_set(session, handle, owner)
            columns = list(rs.columns)
            params: dict[str, Any] = {"h": handle, "lim": limit}
            where = ["handle = :h", *self._filter_sql(flt or {}, columns, params)]
            tops = [m for m in metrics if m.startswith("top:")]
            if tops:
                return await self._top(session, rs, tops, group_by, where, params)
            gexprs = [self._group_expr(g, columns, time_bucket, i, params) for i, g in enumerate(group_by)]
            mexprs = [self._metric_expr(m, columns, i, params) for i, m in enumerate(metrics or ["count"])]
            select_cols = [*(f"{e} AS g{i}" for i, e in enumerate(gexprs)),
                           *(f"{e} AS m{i}" for i, e in enumerate(mexprs))]
            sql = f"SELECT {', '.join(select_cols)} FROM mcp.result_items WHERE {' AND '.join(where)}"
            if gexprs:
                order = ", ".join(f"g{i}" for i in range(len(gexprs)))
                sql += f" GROUP BY {order} ORDER BY {order}"
            sql += " LIMIT :lim"
            rows = (await session.execute(text(sql), params)).all()
        cols = [*group_by, *(metrics or ["count"])]
        out_rows = [[_num(v) for v in row] for row in rows]
        return {
            "summary": f"{len(out_rows)} grup dari {rs.total} baris handle {handle}",
            "cols": cols,
            "rows": out_rows,
        }

    async def _top(self, session: AsyncSession, rs: ResultSet, tops: list[str], group_by: list[str],
                   where: list[str], params: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if group_by or len(tops) != 1:
            raise ValidationFailed("top:x:n hanya satu metrik dan tanpa group_by",
                                   details={"field": "metrics"})
        parts = tops[0].split(":")
        if len(parts) != 3 or not parts[2].isdigit():
            raise ValidationFailed("format metrik top harus top:<kolom>:<n>", details={"field": "metrics"})
        col, n = parts[1], min(int(parts[2]), 50)
        self._check_fields([col], list(rs.columns), "metrics")
        params.update(tc=col, tn=n)
        sql = (
            "SELECT v, count(*) AS c FROM ("
            "  SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(data->:tc) AS v FROM mcp.result_items "
            f"  WHERE {' AND '.join(where)} AND jsonb_typeof(data->:tc) = 'array'"
            "  UNION ALL "
            "  SELECT data->>:tc AS v FROM mcp.result_items "
            f"  WHERE {' AND '.join(where)} AND jsonb_typeof(data->:tc) NOT IN ('array', 'null')"
            ") t GROUP BY v ORDER BY c DESC, v LIMIT :tn"
        )
        rows = (await session.execute(text(sql), params)).all()
        return {
            "summary": f"top {len(rows)} nilai {col} dari {rs.total} baris",
            "cols": [col, "count"],
            "rows": [[r.v, int(r.c)] for r in rows],
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ export
    async def export(self, handle: str, owner: Owner, fmt: Literal["csv", "jsonl", "xlsx"]) -> tuple[Path, int]:
        if self.export_dir is None:
            raise ValidationFailed("export tidak dikonfigurasi")
        self.export_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            rs = await self.get_set(session, handle, owner)
            columns = list(rs.columns)
            result = await session.stream(
                select(ResultItem.data).where(ResultItem.handle == handle).order_by(ResultItem.idx)
            )
            rows = [r[0] async for r in result]
        stamp = now().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
        path = self.export_dir / f"{handle}-{stamp}.{fmt}"
        if fmt == "jsonl":
            path.write_bytes(b"".join(orjson.dumps(r) + b"\n" for r in rows))
        elif fmt == "csv":
            buf = io.StringIO()
            writer = csv.writer(buf)
            writer.writerow(columns)
            for r in rows:
                writer.writerow([_cell(r.get(c)) for c in columns])
            path.write_text(buf.getvalue(), encoding="utf-8-sig")
        else:
            from openpyxl import Workbook

            wb = Workbook(write_only=True)
            ws = wb.create_sheet(handle)
            ws.append(columns)
            for r in rows:
                ws.append([_cell(r.get(c)) for c in columns])
            wb.save(path)
        return path, len(rows)


def _cell(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, list | dict):
        return orjson.dumps(value).decode()
    return value


def _num(value: Any) -> Any:
    from decimal import Decimal

    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return float(value)
    return value

"""Result store: data besar disimpan sebagai handle (`h_…`) dan dibaca bertahap (MCP_SPEC §3 T2–T4).

Baris disimpan di `mcp.result_items.data` (jsonb, kolom terproyeksi). Paginasi keyset
`(data->'col', idx)` dengan cursor base64; agregasi dilakukan di SQL.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import csv
import io
import uuid
from collections.abc import Iterable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal

import orjson
from sqlalchemy import insert, select, text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from mcp_marketing.core.database import Database
from mcp_marketing.core.errors import NotFound, ValidationFailed
from mcp_marketing.models import ResultItem, ResultSet
from mcp_marketing.utils.ids import new_handle
from mcp_marketing.utils.text import truncate
from mcp_marketing.utils.time import now

BATCH = 1_000
FILTER_OPS = frozenset(
    {"eq", "ne", "lt", "lte", "gt", "gte", "in", "contains", "icontains", "starts_with",
     "is_null", "between"}
)
TIME_BUCKETS = ("hour", "day", "week", "month")
SIMPLE_METRICS = ("sum", "avg", "min", "max", "p50", "p90")
MAX_GROUP_BY = 3


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Owner:
    client_id: str | None
    run_id: str | None = None
    is_admin: bool = False


def _json_safe(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, uuid.UUID):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, list | tuple):
        return [_json_safe(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: _json_safe(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    return value


def _to_ts(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str) and value:
        try:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        except ValueError:
            return None
    return None


def _to_num(value: Any) -> float | None:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return float(value)
    if isinstance(value, int | float):
        return float(value)
    return None


def encode_cursor(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(orjson.dumps(payload)).decode().rstrip("=")


def decode_cursor(cursor: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        padded = cursor + "=" * (-len(cursor) % 4)
        data = orjson.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(padded))
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise ValueError
        return data
    except ValueError:
        raise ValidationFailed("cursor tidak valid", details={"field": "cursor"}) from None


class ResultStore:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, *, ttl_days: int = 30, timezone: str = "Asia/Jakarta",
                 export_dir: Path | None = None) -> None:
        self.db = db
        self.ttl_days = ttl_days
        self.timezone = timezone
        self.export_dir = export_dir

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ create
    async def create(
        self,
        *,
        kind: str,
        columns: list[str],
        rows: Iterable[dict[str, Any]],
        stats: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        source_ref: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        owner: Owner,
        job_id: str | None = None,
        sort_ts: str | None = None,
        sort_num: str | None = None,
        ref_id: str | None = None,
        ttl_days: int | None = None,
    ) -> ResultSet:
        handle = new_handle()
        expires = now() + timedelta(days=ttl_days or self.ttl_days)
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            rs = ResultSet(
                handle=handle,
                kind=kind,
                client_id=uuid.UUID(owner.client_id) if owner.client_id else None,
                run_id=uuid.UUID(owner.run_id) if owner.run_id else None,
                job_id=job_id,
                columns=list(columns),
                total=0,
                stats=_json_safe(stats or {}),
                source_ref=_json_safe(source_ref or {}),
                expires_at=expires,
            )
            session.add(rs)
            await session.flush()
            total = 0
            batch: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for row in rows:
                batch.append(
                    {
                        "handle": handle,
                        "idx": total,
                        "ref_id": row.get(ref_id) if ref_id else None,
                        "data": _json_safe({c: row.get(c) for c in columns}),
                        "sort_ts": _to_ts(row.get(sort_ts)) if sort_ts else None,
                        "sort_num": _to_num(row.get(sort_num)) if sort_num else None,
                    }
                )
                total += 1
                if len(batch) >= BATCH:
                    await session.execute(insert(ResultItem), batch)
                    batch = []
            if batch:
                await session.execute(insert(ResultItem), batch)
            rs.total = total
        return rs

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ read
    async def get_set(self, session: AsyncSession, handle: str, owner: Owner) -> ResultSet:
        rs = await session.get(ResultSet, handle)
        if rs is None or rs.expires_at <= now() or not self._can_read(rs, owner):
            # tidak membedakan "tidak ada" dan "bukan milikmu" agar handle tidak bisa ditebak
            raise NotFound(f"Handle {handle} tidak ditemukan atau kedaluwarsa")
        return rs

    @staticmethod
    def _can_read(rs: ResultSet, owner: Owner) -> bool:
        if owner.is_admin:
            return True
        if owner.client_id and rs.client_id and str(rs.client_id) == owner.client_id:
            return True
        return bool(owner.run_id and rs.run_id and str(rs.run_id) == owner.run_id)

    @staticmethod
    def _check_fields(fields: Iterable[str], columns: list[str], param: str) -> None:
        unknown = [f for f in fields if f not in columns]
        if unknown:
            raise ValidationFailed(
                f"{param} tidak dikenal: {', '.join(unknown)}",
                details={"field": param, "allowed": columns},
            )

    def _filter_sql(
        self, flt: dict[str, Any], columns: list[str], params: dict[str, Any]
    ) -> list[str]:
        self._check_fields(flt.keys(), columns, "filter")
        clauses: list[str] = []
        for i, (field, cond) in enumerate(flt.items()):
            if not isinstance(cond, dict):
                cond = {"op": "eq", "value": cond}
            op = cond.get("op", "eq")
            value = cond.get("value")
            if op not in FILTER_OPS:
                raise ValidationFailed(f"operator filter tidak dikenal: {op}", details={"field": "filter"})
            fk, pk = f"f{i}", f"v{i}"
            params[fk] = field
            txt = f"(data->>:{fk})"
            num = f"(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(data->:{fk}) = 'number' THEN (data->>:{fk})::numeric END)"
            numeric = isinstance(value, int | float) and not isinstance(value, bool)
            col = num if numeric else txt
            sql_ops = {"eq": "=", "ne": "<>", "lt": "<", "lte": "<=", "gt": ">", "gte": ">="}
            if op in sql_ops:
                params[pk] = value if numeric else (None if value is None else str(value).lower()
                                                    if isinstance(value, bool) else str(value))
                clauses.append(f"{col} {sql_ops[op]} :{pk}")
            elif op == "in":
                if not isinstance(value, list) or not value:
                    raise ValidationFailed("filter 'in' butuh list", details={"field": "filter"})
                params[pk] = [str(v) for v in value]
                clauses.append(f"{txt} = ANY(:{pk})")
            elif op in ("contains", "icontains", "starts_with"):
                params[pk] = str(value)
                like = "ILIKE" if op == "icontains" else "LIKE"
                pattern = f"'%' || :{pk} || '%'" if op != "starts_with" else f":{pk} || '%'"
                # untuk array (mis. hashtags) contains = elemen ada di array
                clauses.append(
                    f"(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(data->:{fk}) = 'array' "
                    f"THEN (data->:{fk}) ? :{pk} ELSE {txt} {like} {pattern} END)"
                )
            elif op == "is_null":
                clauses.append(f"(data->:{fk} IS NULL OR data->:{fk} = 'null'::jsonb)"
                               if value in (None, True) else
                               f"(data->:{fk} IS NOT NULL AND data->:{fk} <> 'null'::jsonb)")
            elif op == "between":
                if not isinstance(value, list) or len(value) != 2:
                    raise ValidationFailed("filter 'between' butuh [a, b]", details={"field": "filter"})
                lo, hi = value
                both_num = all(isinstance(v, int | float) and not isinstance(v, bool) for v in value)
                c = num if both_num else txt
                params[f"{pk}a"], params[f"{pk}b"] = (lo, hi) if both_num else (str(lo), str(hi))
                clauses.append(f"{c} BETWEEN :{pk}a AND :{pk}b")
        return clauses

    async def page(
        self,
        handle: str,
        owner: Owner,
        *,

        order_by: str | None = None,

        cursor: str | None = None,

            params: dict[str, Any] = {"h": handle, "lim": limit + 1}

                "LIMIT :lim"

            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
            "truncated": False,

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ aggregate
