"""Scheduler cron (`mcp.schedules`, zona TIMEZONE): tepat satu job per slot walau banyak worker.

Klaim slot atomik: `UPDATE schedules SET last_run_at = slot WHERE last_run_at < slot` — hanya
worker yang berhasil meng-update yang meng-enqueue job.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from croniter import croniter
from sqlalchemy import select, text

from mcp_marketing.core.database import Database
from mcp_marketing.core.logging import get_logger
from mcp_marketing.models import Schedule
from mcp_marketing.utils.crypto import sha256_hex
from mcp_marketing.utils.time import now
from mcp_marketing.worker.queue import JobQueue

log = get_logger(__name__)


def latest_slot(cron: str, at: datetime, tz: str) -> datetime:
    """Slot cron terakhir yang <= `at` (UTC aware)."""
    # get_prev() eksklusif terhadap base; geser 1 detik agar slot tepat `at` ikut terhitung
    local = at.astimezone(ZoneInfo(tz)) + timedelta(seconds=1)
    return croniter(cron, local).get_prev(datetime).astimezone(ZoneInfo("UTC"))  # type: ignore[no-any-return]


def next_slot(cron: str, at: datetime, tz: str) -> datetime:
    local = at.astimezone(ZoneInfo(tz))
    return croniter(cron, local).get_next(datetime).astimezone(ZoneInfo("UTC"))


class Scheduler:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, queue: JobQueue, *, timezone: str = "Asia/Jakarta") -> None:
        self.db = db
        self.queue = queue
        self.timezone = timezone

    async def tick(self, at: datetime | None = None) -> list[str]:
        at = at or now()
        enqueued: list[str] = []
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            schedules = list((await session.scalars(select(Schedule).where(Schedule.is_enabled.is_(True)))).all())
        for sched in schedules:
            try:
                slot = latest_slot(sched.cron, at, self.timezone)
            except (ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
                log.warning("scheduler.bad_cron", schedule=sched.name, error=str(exc))
                continue
            async with self.db.session() as session:
                claimed = (
                    await session.execute(
                        text(
                            "UPDATE mcp.schedules SET last_run_at = :slot, next_run_at = :next "
                            "WHERE id = :id AND (last_run_at IS NULL OR last_run_at < :slot) RETURNING id"
                        ),
                        {"slot": slot, "next": next_slot(sched.cron, at, self.timezone), "id": sched.id},
                    )
                ).first()
            if claimed is None:
                continue
            accepted = await self.queue.enqueue(
                sched.job_kind,
                dict(sched.params or {}),
                client_id=None,
                dedupe_key=sha256_hex(f"{sched.id}|{slot.isoformat()}"),
                priority=8,
                max_attempts=2,
            )
            enqueued.append(accepted.job_id)
            log.info("scheduler.enqueued", schedule=sched.name, slot=slot.isoformat(), job_id=accepted.job_id)
        return enqueued

    from datetime import timedelta

    from mcp_marketing.utils.time import now

    return now() - timedelta(days=days)

"""Toolset `job`: status/tunggu/batal/daftar job asinkron (MCP_SPEC §2.4, §4.1, T12)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from mcp_marketing.core.errors import ValidationFailed
from mcp_marketing.schemas.common import Table, ToolInput
from mcp_marketing.server.registry import ToolContext, tool
from mcp_marketing.worker.queue import JobOwner, JobQueue, job_view

JOB_PATTERN = r"^j_[0-9a-z]{10}$"
JobStatus = Literal["queued", "running", "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"]


def _queue(ctx: ToolContext) -> JobQueue:
    if ctx.services.jobs is None:
        raise ValidationFailed("Job queue tidak aktif di proses ini")
    return ctx.services.jobs


def _owner(ctx: ToolContext) -> JobOwner:
    return JobOwner(client_id=ctx.client.id, run_id=ctx.run_id, is_admin=ctx.client.is_admin)


class Progress(BaseModel):
    done: int
    total: int | None = None


class JobStatusOut(BaseModel):
    summary: str
    job_id: str
    kind: str
    status: JobStatus
    progress: Progress
    message: str | None = None
    result: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    error: dict[str, Any] | None = None


def _status_out(job: Any) -> JobStatusOut:
    view = job_view(job)
    done, total = view["progress"]["done"], view["progress"]["total"]
    pct = f" {done}/{total}" if total else ""
    return JobStatusOut(summary=f"Job {job.id} ({job.kind}) {job.status}{pct}", **view)


class JobStatusIn(ToolInput):
    job_id: str = Field(pattern=JOB_PATTERN)


@tool(
    name="job_status",
    toolset="job",
    summary="Status & progres job; hasil hanya saat selesai",
    description="Get job status and progress. The full result (handle + summary) is returned only "
    "once the job has succeeded.",
    input_model=JobStatusIn,
    output_model=JobStatusOut,
)
async def job_status(inp: JobStatusIn, ctx: ToolContext) -> JobStatusOut:
    return _status_out(await _queue(ctx).get(inp.job_id, _owner(ctx)))


class JobWaitIn(ToolInput):
    job_id: str = Field(pattern=JOB_PATTERN)
    timeout_s: int = Field(default=15, ge=0, le=20)


@tool(
    name="job_wait",
    toolset="job",
    summary="Tunggu job selesai (maks 20 s) tanpa polling berulang",
    description="Block up to timeout_s (<=20) until the job finishes, then return the same payload "
    "as job_status. Avoids repeated polling.",
    input_model=JobWaitIn,
    output_model=JobStatusOut,
    timeout_s=24,
)
async def job_wait(inp: JobWaitIn, ctx: ToolContext) -> JobStatusOut:
    return _status_out(await _queue(ctx).wait(inp.job_id, _owner(ctx), inp.timeout_s))


class JobCancelOut(BaseModel):
    summary: str
    cancelled: bool
    jobs: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


@tool(

"""TASK-07: antrean, worker paralel, resume checkpoint, pembatalan berantai, wait, scheduler."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import time
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import func, select, text, update

from mcp_marketing.core.errors import UpstreamError
from mcp_marketing.models import Job, Schedule, ToolCall, UsageDaily
from mcp_marketing.schemas.common import JobEstimate
from mcp_marketing.server.app import build_asgi_app
from mcp_marketing.server.auth import ClientIdentity
from mcp_marketing.server.services import Services
from mcp_marketing.worker.handlers import default_registry
from mcp_marketing.worker.handlers.base import HandlerRegistry, JobCtx, JobResult
from mcp_marketing.worker.queue import JobOwner, JobQueue
from mcp_marketing.worker.runner import Worker
from mcp_marketing.worker.scheduler import Scheduler

CLIENT = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1"


class Recorder:
    kind = "record"

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.seen: list[str] = []

    async def estimate(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> JobEstimate:
        return JobEstimate(seconds=1)

    async def run(self, job: JobCtx) -> JobResult:
        self.seen.append(job.job_id)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.005)
        return JobResult({"summary": "ok", "n": job.params["n"]}, result_handle=None)


class DaysCrawler:
    """Simulasi crawl 30 hari dengan checkpoint per hari."""

    kind = "crawl_days"

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.processed: list[int] = []
        self.block_after: int | None = None
        self.blocked = asyncio.Event()

    async def estimate(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> JobEstimate:
        return JobEstimate(seconds=30)

    async def run(self, job: JobCtx) -> JobResult:
        start = int(job.checkpoint.get("last_day", 0)) + 1
        for day in range(start, 31):
            self.processed.append(day)
            await job.save_checkpoint({"last_day": day})
            await job.progress(day, 30)
            if self.block_after is not None and day == self.block_after:
                self.blocked.set()
                await asyncio.Event().wait()  # "hang" sampai worker dimatikan
        return JobResult({"summary": "30 hari selesai"})


class Looper:
    kind = "looper"

    async def estimate(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> JobEstimate:
        return JobEstimate(seconds=60)

    async def run(self, job: JobCtx) -> JobResult:
        while True:
            await job.raise_if_cancelled()
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)


class Slow:
    kind = "slow"

    async def estimate(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> JobEstimate:
        return JobEstimate(seconds=5)

    async def run(self, job: JobCtx) -> JobResult:
        job.partial_result = JobResult({"summary": "sebagian", "total": 3})
        await asyncio.sleep(float(job.params.get("sleep", 5)))
        return JobResult({"summary": "selesai"})


class Flaky:
    kind = "flaky"

    async def estimate(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> JobEstimate:
        return JobEstimate(seconds=1)

    async def run(self, job: JobCtx) -> JobResult:
        if job.attempts == 1:
            raise UpstreamError("sementara gagal")
        return JobResult({"summary": "berhasil di percobaan 2"})


def registry(*handlers: Any) -> HandlerRegistry:
    reg = HandlerRegistry()
    for h in handlers:
        reg.register(h)
    return reg


def make_worker(services: Services, reg: HandlerRegistry, wid: str, **kw: Any) -> Worker:
    queue = JobQueue(services.db, estimator=reg)
    return Worker(services, queue, reg, worker_id=wid, use_process_pool=False, poll_interval_s=0.05, **kw)


async def _wait_status(services: Services, job_id: str, statuses: tuple[str, ...], timeout: float = 10) -> Job:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        async with services.db.session() as s:
            job = await s.get(Job, job_id)
        if job is not None and job.status in statuses:
            return job
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
    raise AssertionError(f"job {job_id} tidak mencapai {statuses}")


async def test_two_workers_each_job_exactly_once(services: Services) -> None:
    rec = Recorder()
    reg = registry(rec)
    queue = JobQueue(services.db, estimator=reg)
    ids = [(await queue.enqueue("record", {"n": i}, client_id=CLIENT)).job_id for i in range(100)]
    w1, w2 = make_worker(services, reg, "w1", concurrency=4), make_worker(services, reg, "w2", concurrency=4)
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(w1.run()), asyncio.create_task(w2.run())]
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        async with services.db.session() as s:
            done = await s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(Job).where(Job.status == "succeeded"))
        if done == 100:
            break
        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    w1.stop()
    w2.stop()
    await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    assert sorted(rec.seen) == sorted(ids)
    assert len(rec.seen) == len(set(rec.seen)) == 100


async def test_dedupe_returns_existing_job(services: Services) -> None:
    queue = JobQueue(services.db)
    a = await queue.enqueue("record", {"n": 1}, client_id=CLIENT)
    b = await queue.enqueue("record", {"n": 1}, client_id=CLIENT)
    c = await queue.enqueue("record", {"n": 2}, client_id=CLIENT)
    assert a.job_id == b.job_id != c.job_id


async def test_killed_worker_job_reaped_and_resumed_from_checkpoint(services: Services) -> None:
    crawler = DaysCrawler()
    crawler.block_after = 12
    reg = registry(crawler)
    w1 = make_worker(services, reg, "dead-worker")
    job_id = (await w1.queue.enqueue("crawl_days", {"keyword": "kopi"}, client_id=CLIENT)).job_id

    async def no_release(job_id: str, worker_id: str) -> None:  # worker "mati" tanpa cleanup
        return None

    w1.queue.release = no_release  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    task = asyncio.create_task(w1.run_one())
    await asyncio.wait_for(crawler.blocked.wait(), 5)
    task.cancel()
    await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        await s.execute(update(Job).where(Job.id == job_id).values(heartbeat_at=datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(minutes=2)))
    assert await w1.queue.reap() == 1
    crawler.block_after = None
    w2 = make_worker(services, reg, "w2")
    assert await w2.run_one()
    job = await _wait_status(services, job_id, ("succeeded",))
    assert crawler.processed == list(range(1, 31))
    assert job.checkpoint == {"last_day": 30} and job.attempts == 2


async def test_reaper_fails_job_after_max_attempts(services: Services) -> None:
    queue = JobQueue(services.db)
    job_id = (await queue.enqueue("record", {"n": 9}, client_id=CLIENT, max_attempts=1)).job_id
    await queue.pick("ghost")
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        await s.execute(update(Job).where(Job.id == job_id).values(heartbeat_at=datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(minutes=5)))
    await queue.reap()
    job = await _wait_status(services, job_id, ("failed",))
    assert job.error["code"] == "WORKER_LOST"  # type: ignore[index]


async def test_cancel_parent_cancels_running_child_within_5s(services: Services) -> None:
    reg = registry(Looper())
    worker = make_worker(services, reg, "w-cancel")
    run_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    parent = (await worker.queue.enqueue("looper", {"p": 1}, client_id=CLIENT, run_id=run_id)).job_id
    child = (await worker.queue.enqueue("looper", {"c": 1}, client_id=CLIENT, parent_job_id=parent)).job_id

        self.processed: list[int] = []
        self.block_after: int | None = None
        self.blocked = asyncio.Event()

    async def estimate(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> JobEstimate:
        return JobEstimate(seconds=30)

    async def run(self, job: JobCtx) -> JobResult:
        start = int(job.checkpoint.get("last_day", 0)) + 1
        for day in range(start, 31):
            self.processed.append(day)
            await job.save_checkpoint({"last_day": day})
            await job.progress(day, 30)
            if self.block_after is not None and day == self.block_after:
                self.blocked.set()
                await asyncio.Event().wait()  # "hang" sampai worker dimatikan
        return JobResult({"summary": "30 hari selesai"})


class Looper:
    kind = "looper"

    async def estimate(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> JobEstimate:
        return JobEstimate(seconds=60)

    async def run(self, job: JobCtx) -> JobResult:
        while True:
            await job.raise_if_cancelled()
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)


class Slow:
    kind = "slow"

    async def estimate(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> JobEstimate:
        return JobEstimate(seconds=5)

    async def run(self, job: JobCtx) -> JobResult:
        job.partial_result = JobResult({"summary": "sebagian", "total": 3})
        await asyncio.sleep(float(job.params.get("sleep", 5)))
        return JobResult({"summary": "selesai"})


class Flaky:
    kind = "flaky"

    async def estimate(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> JobEstimate:
        return JobEstimate(seconds=1)

    async def run(self, job: JobCtx) -> JobResult:
        if job.attempts == 1:
            raise UpstreamError("sementara gagal")
        return JobResult({"summary": "berhasil di percobaan 2"})


def registry(*handlers: Any) -> HandlerRegistry:
    reg = HandlerRegistry()
    for h in handlers:
        reg.register(h)
    return reg


def make_worker(services: Services, reg: HandlerRegistry, wid: str, **kw: Any) -> Worker:
    queue = JobQueue(services.db, estimator=reg)
    return Worker(services, queue, reg, worker_id=wid, use_process_pool=False, poll_interval_s=0.05, **kw)


async def _wait_status(services: Services, job_id: str, statuses: tuple[str, ...], timeout: float = 10) -> Job:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        async with services.db.session() as s:
            job = await s.get(Job, job_id)
        if job is not None and job.status in statuses:
            return job
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
    raise AssertionError(f"job {job_id} tidak mencapai {statuses}")


async def test_two_workers_each_job_exactly_once(services: Services) -> None:
    rec = Recorder()
    reg = registry(rec)
    queue = JobQueue(services.db, estimator=reg)
    ids = [(await queue.enqueue("record", {"n": i}, client_id=CLIENT)).job_id for i in range(100)]
    w1, w2 = make_worker(services, reg, "w1", concurrency=4), make_worker(services, reg, "w2", concurrency=4)
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(w1.run()), asyncio.create_task(w2.run())]
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        async with services.db.session() as s:
            done = await s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(Job).where(Job.status == "succeeded"))
        if done == 100:
            break
        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    w1.stop()
    w2.stop()
    await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    assert sorted(rec.seen) == sorted(ids)
    assert len(rec.seen) == len(set(rec.seen)) == 100


async def test_dedupe_returns_existing_job(services: Services) -> None:
    queue = JobQueue(services.db)
    a = await queue.enqueue("record", {"n": 1}, client_id=CLIENT)
    b = await queue.enqueue("record", {"n": 1}, client_id=CLIENT)
    c = await queue.enqueue("record", {"n": 2}, client_id=CLIENT)
    assert a.job_id == b.job_id != c.job_id


async def test_killed_worker_job_reaped_and_resumed_from_checkpoint(services: Services) -> None:
    crawler = DaysCrawler()
    crawler.block_after = 12
    reg = registry(crawler)
    w1 = make_worker(services, reg, "dead-worker")
    job_id = (await w1.queue.enqueue("crawl_days", {"keyword": "kopi"}, client_id=CLIENT)).job_id

    async def no_release(job_id: str, worker_id: str) -> None:  # worker "mati" tanpa cleanup
        return None

    w1.queue.release = no_release  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    task = asyncio.create_task(w1.run_one())
    await asyncio.wait_for(crawler.blocked.wait(), 5)
    task.cancel()
    await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        await s.execute(update(Job).where(Job.id == job_id).values(heartbeat_at=datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(minutes=2)))
    assert await w1.queue.reap() == 1
    crawler.block_after = None
    w2 = make_worker(services, reg, "w2")
    assert await w2.run_one()
    job = await _wait_status(services, job_id, ("succeeded",))
    assert crawler.processed == list(range(1, 31))
    assert job.checkpoint == {"last_day": 30} and job.attempts == 2


async def test_reaper_fails_job_after_max_attempts(services: Services) -> None:
    queue = JobQueue(services.db)
    job_id = (await queue.enqueue("record", {"n": 9}, client_id=CLIENT, max_attempts=1)).job_id
    await queue.pick("ghost")
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        await s.execute(update(Job).where(Job.id == job_id).values(heartbeat_at=datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(minutes=5)))
    await queue.reap()
    job = await _wait_status(services, job_id, ("failed",))
    assert job.error["code"] == "WORKER_LOST"  # type: ignore[index]


async def test_cancel_parent_cancels_running_child_within_5s(services: Services) -> None:
    reg = registry(Looper())
    worker = make_worker(services, reg, "w-cancel")
    run_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    parent = (await worker.queue.enqueue("looper", {"p": 1}, client_id=CLIENT, run_id=run_id)).job_id
    child = (await worker.queue.enqueue("looper", {"c": 1}, client_id=CLIENT, parent_job_id=parent)).job_id
    grandchild = (await worker.queue.enqueue("looper", {"g": 1}, client_id=CLIENT, parent_job_id=child)).job_id
    task = asyncio.create_task(worker.run())
    await _wait_status(services, parent, ("running",))
    await _wait_status(services, child, ("running",))
    started = time.monotonic()
    cancelled = await worker.queue.cancel_run_jobs(run_id)
    assert set(cancelled) == {parent, child, grandchild}
    for jid in (parent, child, grandchild):
        await _wait_status(services, jid, ("cancelled",), timeout=5)
    assert time.monotonic() - started <= 5
    worker.stop()
    await task


async def test_timeout_keeps_partial_result(services: Services) -> None:
    reg = registry(Slow())
    worker = make_worker(services, reg, "w-timeout")
    job_id = (await worker.queue.enqueue("slow", {"sleep": 5}, client_id=CLIENT, timeout_s=1)).job_id
    await worker.run_one()
    job = await _wait_status(services, job_id, ("failed",))
    assert job.error["code"] == "JOB_TIMEOUT"  # type: ignore[index]
    assert job.result == {"summary": "sebagian", "total": 3, "partial": True}


async def test_retryable_error_requeued_then_succeeds(services: Services) -> None:
    reg = registry(Flaky())
    worker = make_worker(services, reg, "w-flaky")
    job_id = (await worker.queue.enqueue("flaky", {}, client_id=CLIENT)).job_id
    await worker.run_one()
    job = await _wait_status(services, job_id, ("queued",))
    assert job.error["code"] == "UPSTREAM_ERROR"  # type: ignore[index]
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        await s.execute(update(Job).where(Job.id == job_id).values(run_after=datetime.now(UTC)))
    await worker.run_one()
    assert (await _wait_status(services, job_id, ("succeeded",))).attempts == 2


async def test_job_wait_returns_quickly_after_completion(services: Services) -> None:
    reg = registry(Slow())
    worker = make_worker(services, reg, "w-wait")
    job_id = (await worker.queue.enqueue("slow", {"sleep": 1.0}, client_id=CLIENT)).job_id
    owner = JobOwner(client_id=CLIENT)
    waiter = asyncio.create_task(worker.queue.wait(job_id, owner, 15))
    await worker.run_one()
    finished = time.monotonic()
    job = await waiter
    assert job.status == "succeeded"
    assert time.monotonic() - finished < 1.0


async def test_scheduler_one_job_per_slot_with_two_schedulers(services: Services) -> None:
    queue = JobQueue(services.db)
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        s.add(Schedule(name="every-minute", cron="*/1 * * * *", job_kind="record", params={"n": 0}))
    s1, s2 = Scheduler(services.db, queue), Scheduler(services.db, queue)
    at = datetime(2026, 11, 3, 3, 0, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
    first = await asyncio.gather(s1.tick(at), s2.tick(at))
    assert sum(len(x) for x in first) == 1
    assert await s1.tick(at + timedelta(seconds=20)) == []
    assert len(await s2.tick(at + timedelta(seconds=40))) == 1  # slot menit berikutnya
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        assert await s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(Job)) == 2


async def test_job_tools_ownership_and_t12(services: Services) -> None:
    from mcp_marketing.services.results.result_store import Owner

    reg = registry(Recorder())
    services.jobs = JobQueue(services.db, estimator=reg)
    worker = Worker(services, services.jobs, reg, worker_id="w-tools", use_process_pool=False)

    me = ClientIdentity(id=CLIENT, name="me", kind="external", toolsets=frozenset({"job"}), rpm_limit=1000)

async def test_maintenance_handlers(services: Services) -> None:
    reg = default_registry()
    worker = make_worker(services, reg, "w-maint")
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        for status in ("ok", "ok", "cached", "error"):
            s.add(ToolCall(request_id="r", tool="x_search", args_hash="0" * 64, status=status, duration_ms=5,

"""Kontrak Dashboard 1.0 (M1_MCP_INTEGRATION §3, §5; `mcp.schema.ts`) dalam Pydantic.

Input dari Dashboard dibuat toleran (`extra="ignore"`: penambahan field di contract 1.x minor tidak
memutus). Payload KELUAR (webhook) dibuat ketat agar setara Zod Dashboard.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import uuid
from datetime import date
from typing import Annotated, Any, Literal

from pydantic import (
    AfterValidator,
    BaseModel,
    ConfigDict,
    Field,
    StringConstraints,
    field_validator,
    model_validator,
)

from mcp_marketing.schemas.blocks import validate_block_content

CONTRACT_MAJOR = 1
CONTRACT_RE = re.compile(r"^1\.\d+$")

MAX_BLOCK_OPS = 50
MAX_SUBTASKS = 20
MAX_DEPTH = 3
MAX_BODY = 1_000_000
MAX_COMMENT = 10_000
MAX_BLOCK_JSON = 65_536
MAX_CONTEXT_BLOCKS = 200

EVENT_TYPES = (
    "agent.task.started",
    "agent.status.changed",
    "agent.block.appended",
    "agent.subtask.created",
    "agent.comment.added",
    "agent.task.completed",
    "agent.task.failed",
)
EventType = Literal[
    "agent.task.started",
    "agent.status.changed",
    "agent.block.appended",
    "agent.subtask.created",
    "agent.comment.added",
    "agent.task.completed",
    "agent.task.failed",
]
TaskPriority = Literal["none", "low", "medium", "high", "urgent"]


def _lower_uuid(v: str) -> str:
    return str(uuid.UUID(v)).lower()


def _date_str(v: str) -> str:
    date.fromisoformat(v)
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", v):
        raise ValueError("Format tanggal harus YYYY-MM-DD")
    return v


Uuid = Annotated[str, AfterValidator(_lower_uuid)]
DateStr = Annotated[str, AfterValidator(_date_str)]


class _In(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="ignore")


class _Out(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ input dari Dashboard
class TaskSnapshot(_In):
    id: Uuid
    project_id: Uuid
    workspace_id: Uuid | None = None
    parent_task_id: Uuid | None = None
    depth: int = 1
    title: str
    status: str = "todo"
    priority: str = "none"
    start_date: str | None = None
    end_date: str | None = None
    is_milestone: bool = False
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    url: str | None = None


class ContextBlock(_In):
    id: str
    parent_block_id: str | None = None
    block_type: str
    content_json: Any = None
    plain_text: str = ""
    version: int = 1


class SubtaskRef(_In):
    id: str
    title: str
    status: str | None = None
    depth: int | None = None


class Person(_In):
    user_id: str | None = None
    display_name: str | None = None


class Author(_In):
    type: str = "user"
    id: str | None = None
    display_name: str | None = None


class Callback(_In):
    webhook_url: str
    agent_api_base_url: str


class Limits(_In):
    max_depth: int = MAX_DEPTH
    max_subtasks_per_event: int = MAX_SUBTASKS
    max_blocks_per_event: int = MAX_BLOCK_OPS


class ContractInput(_In):
    contract_version: str = Field(description="Versi kontrak Dashboard, mis. 1.0")
    run_id: Uuid


class DispatchInput(ContractInput):
    agent_key: str = Field(max_length=100)
    agent_id: Uuid
    task: TaskSnapshot
    task_description: str = ""
    context_blocks: list[ContextBlock] = Field(default_factory=list)
    subtasks: list[SubtaskRef] = Field(default_factory=list)
    dispatched_by: Person | None = None
    callback: Callback
    limits: Limits | None = None


class EstimationInput(ContractInput):
    agent_key: str = Field(max_length=100)
    task: TaskSnapshot
    task_description: str = ""
    context_blocks: list[ContextBlock] = Field(default_factory=list)
    earliest_start_date: DateStr
    timezone: str = "Asia/Jakarta"


class CommentIn(_In):
    id: str
    parent_comment_id: str | None = None
    content: str
    author: Author = Field(default_factory=Author)
    created_at: str | None = None


class ThreadItem(_In):
    id: str
    content: str
    author: Author = Field(default_factory=Author)


class MentionInput(ContractInput):
    agent_key: str = Field(max_length=100)
    agent_id: Uuid
    task: TaskSnapshot | None = None
    project_id: Uuid
    comment: CommentIn
    thread: list[ThreadItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    context_blocks: list[ContextBlock] = Field(default_factory=list)
    callback: Callback


class PromptBlockRef(_In):
    id: Uuid
    prompt: str = ""
    version: int = 1


class PromptBlockInput(ContractInput):
    agent_key: str = Field(max_length=100)
    agent_id: Uuid
    task: TaskSnapshot | None = None
    project_id: Uuid
    prompt_block: PromptBlockRef
    context_blocks: list[ContextBlock] = Field(default_factory=list)
    callback: Callback


class CancelInput(ContractInput):
    mcp_run_id: str | None = None
    reason: str = "user_cancelled"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ output ke Dashboard
class DispatchOutput(BaseModel):
    accepted: bool
    mcp_run_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)


class EstimationOutput(BaseModel):
    start_date: DateStr
    end_date: DateStr
    estimated_days: float | None = None
    confidence: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1)
    message: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=2000)


class CancelOutput(BaseModel):
    cancelled: bool


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ webhook (ketat)
class BlockInput(_Out):
    id: Uuid | None = None
    parent_block_id: Uuid | None = None
    block_type: Annotated[str, StringConstraints(max_length=32)]
    content_json: Any = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _content(self) -> BlockInput:
        self.content_json = validate_block_content(self.block_type, self.content_json)
        return self

"""Signature webhook MCP -> Dashboard: `sha256=HMAC_SHA256(secret, "<ts>.<raw_body>")`.

Setara `signMcpPayload` di `backend/src/utils/helpers/crypto.util.ts`; body yang dikirim harus
byte yang sama persis dengan yang ditandatangani.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import time


def sign(secret: str, timestamp: str, raw_body: bytes) -> str:
    mac = hmac.new(secret.encode(), digestmod=hashlib.sha256)
    mac.update(f"{timestamp}.".encode())
    mac.update(raw_body)
    return f"sha256={mac.hexdigest()}"


def signed_headers(secret: str, raw_body: bytes, *, now: float | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    ts = str(int(now if now is not None else time.time()))
    return {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "X-MCP-Timestamp": ts,
        "X-MCP-Signature": sign(secret, ts, raw_body),
    }


def verify(secrets: list[str], timestamp: str | None, signature: str | None, raw_body: bytes,
           *, tolerance_s: int = 300, now: float | None = None) -> str:
    """Port `verifyMcpSignature` (dipakai test & server webhook palsu): ok|missing|expired|invalid."""
    if not timestamp or not signature or raw_body is None:
        return "missing"
    try:
        ts = int(timestamp)
    except ValueError:
        return "expired"
    current = int(now if now is not None else time.time())
    if abs(current - ts) > tolerance_s:
        return "expired"
    ok = any(s and hmac.compare_digest(sign(s, timestamp, raw_body), signature) for s in secrets)
    return "ok" if ok else "invalid"

"""Pemecah batch agar setiap event patuh batas kontrak (≤ 50 operasi blok / ≤ 900 KB, ≤ 20 subtask)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
from typing import Any, TypeVar

import orjson

from mcp_marketing.schemas.contract import MAX_BLOCK_OPS, MAX_SUBTASKS

MAX_EVENT_BYTES = 900_000
T = TypeVar("T")


def chunk_block_ops(ops: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], *, max_ops: int = MAX_BLOCK_OPS,
                    max_bytes: int = MAX_EVENT_BYTES) -> list[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    chunks: list[list[dict[str, Any]]] = []
    current: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    size = 0
    for op in ops:
        op_size = len(orjson.dumps(op)) + 1
        if current and (len(current) >= max_ops or size + op_size > max_bytes):
            chunks.append(current)
            current, size = [], 0
        current.append(op)
        size += op_size
    if current:
        chunks.append(current)
    return chunks


def chunk_subtasks(subtasks: Sequence[T], *, size: int = MAX_SUBTASKS) -> list[list[T]]:
    return [list(subtasks[i : i + size]) for i in range(0, len(subtasks), size)]


def chain_append_ops(blocks: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], *, after_block_id: str | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Ubah daftar blok menjadi operasi `append` berurutan.

    Bila `after_block_id` diisi (mis. prompt block), blok pertama disisip setelahnya dan blok
    berikutnya setelah blok sebelumnya (id dibuat di sisi MCP agar rantai stabil antar batch).
    """
    import uuid

    ops: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    previous = after_block_id
    for block in blocks:
        block_id = block.get("id") or str(uuid.uuid4())
        op: dict[str, Any] = {"op": "append", "block": {**block, "id": block_id}}
        if previous is not None:
            op["after_block_id"] = previous
            previous = block_id
        ops.append(op)
    return ops

"""Signature webhook MCP -> Dashboard: `sha256=HMAC_SHA256(secret, "<ts>.<raw_body>")`.

Setara `signMcpPayload` di `backend/src/utils/helpers/crypto.util.ts`; body yang dikirim harus
byte yang sama persis dengan yang ditandatangani.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import time


def sign(secret: str, timestamp: str, raw_body: bytes) -> str:
    mac = hmac.new(secret.encode(), digestmod=hashlib.sha256)
    mac.update(f"{timestamp}.".encode())
    mac.update(raw_body)
    return f"sha256={mac.hexdigest()}"


def signed_headers(secret: str, raw_body: bytes, *, now: float | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    ts = str(int(now if now is not None else time.time()))
    return {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "X-MCP-Timestamp": ts,
        "X-MCP-Signature": sign(secret, ts, raw_body),
    }


def verify(secrets: list[str], timestamp: str | None, signature: str | None, raw_body: bytes,
           *, tolerance_s: int = 300, now: float | None = None) -> str:
    """Port `verifyMcpSignature` (dipakai test & server webhook palsu): ok|missing|expired|invalid."""
    if not timestamp or not signature or raw_body is None:
        return "missing"
    try:
        ts = int(timestamp)
    except ValueError:
        return "expired"
    current = int(now if now is not None else time.time())
    if abs(current - ts) > tolerance_s:
        return "expired"
    ok = any(s and hmac.compare_digest(sign(s, timestamp, raw_body), signature) for s in secrets)
    return "ok" if ok else "invalid"

"""Pemecah batch agar setiap event patuh batas kontrak (≤ 50 operasi blok / ≤ 900 KB, ≤ 20 subtask)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
from typing import Any, TypeVar

import orjson

from mcp_marketing.schemas.contract import MAX_BLOCK_OPS, MAX_SUBTASKS

MAX_EVENT_BYTES = 900_000
T = TypeVar("T")


def chunk_block_ops(ops: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], *, max_ops: int = MAX_BLOCK_OPS,
                    max_bytes: int = MAX_EVENT_BYTES) -> list[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    chunks: list[list[dict[str, Any]]] = []
    current: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    size = 0
    for op in ops:
        op_size = len(orjson.dumps(op)) + 1
        if current and (len(current) >= max_ops or size + op_size > max_bytes):
            chunks.append(current)
            current, size = [], 0
        current.append(op)
        size += op_size
    if current:
        chunks.append(current)
    return chunks


def chunk_subtasks(subtasks: Sequence[T], *, size: int = MAX_SUBTASKS) -> list[list[T]]:
    return [list(subtasks[i : i + size]) for i in range(0, len(subtasks), size)]


def chain_append_ops(blocks: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], *, after_block_id: str | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Ubah daftar blok menjadi operasi `append` berurutan.

    Bila `after_block_id` diisi (mis. prompt block), blok pertama disisip setelahnya dan blok
    berikutnya setelah blok sebelumnya (id dibuat di sisi MCP agar rantai stabil antar batch).
    """
    import uuid

    ops: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    previous = after_block_id
    for block in blocks:
        block_id = block.get("id") or str(uuid.uuid4())
        op: dict[str, Any] = {"op": "append", "block": {**block, "id": block_id}}
        if previous is not None:
            op["after_block_id"] = previous
            previous = block_id
        ops.append(op)
    return ops

"""Webhook outbox MCP -> Dashboard (contract 1.0 §5): HMAC, idempoten, BERURUTAN per run.

- `emit()` memvalidasi data event, menyimpan baris `webhook_outbox` dengan `seq` = max+1 per run
  (dikunci `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` pada baris `runs`).
- Sender loop: hanya seq terkecil yang belum terkirim per run yang boleh dikirim (satu in-flight
  per run, maks 8 run paralel). Status `sending` dianggap pending saat restart (event_id sama ->
  Dashboard membalas `duplicate` bila sudah pernah diproses).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import contextlib
import time
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any

import httpx
import orjson
from sqlalchemy import select, text, update

from mcp_marketing.core.config import Settings
from mcp_marketing.core.database import Database
from mcp_marketing.core.errors import RunNotActive, ToolError, UpstreamTimeout, ValidationFailed
from mcp_marketing.core.logging import get_logger
from mcp_marketing.core.metrics import OUTBOX_PENDING, WEBHOOK_LATENCY, WEBHOOK_SENT
from mcp_marketing.models import Run, WebhookOutbox
from mcp_marketing.schemas.contract import validate_event_data
from mcp_marketing.services.dashboard import signer
from mcp_marketing.utils.text import truncate
from mcp_marketing.utils.time import now

log = get_logger(__name__)

MAX_PARALLEL_RUNS = 8
MAX_BACKOFF_S = 300
SEND_TIMEOUT_S = 20.0
IDLE_POLL_S = 0.5
INACTIVE_RUN_STATUSES = ("completed", "failed", "cancelled", "cancelled_by_dashboard")


class OutboxRejected(ToolError):
    """Dashboard menolak event (400/401/404/422) atau event gagal terkirim permanen."""

    code = "VALIDATION_ERROR"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EmittedEvent:
    id: int
    event_id: str
    seq: int
    run_id: str


def _iso(dt: Any) -> str:
    return dt.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class Outbox:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, http: httpx.AsyncClient, settings: Settings) -> None:
        self.db = db
        self.http = http
        self.settings = settings
        self._waiters: dict[str, asyncio.Future[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
        self._wake = asyncio.Event()
        self._inflight: set[str] = set()
        self._sem = asyncio.Semaphore(MAX_PARALLEL_RUNS)
        self._stop = asyncio.Event()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ emit
    async def emit(self, run_id: str, event_type: str, data: dict[str, Any], *,
                   task_id: str | None = None, allow_inactive: bool = False) -> EmittedEvent:
        try:
            clean = validate_event_data(event_type, data)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValidationFailed(f"Data event {event_type} tidak valid: {truncate(str(exc), 300)}") from None
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            run = (await session.execute(
                select(Run).where(Run.run_id == uuid.UUID(run_id)).with_for_update()
            )).scalar_one_or_none()
            if run is None:
                raise ValidationFailed(f"Run {run_id} tidak dikenal MCP")
            if not allow_inactive and (run.cancel_requested or run.status in INACTIVE_RUN_STATUSES):
                raise RunNotActive(f"Run {run_id} sudah {run.status}; event tidak dikirim")
            seq = int((await session.execute(
                text("SELECT COALESCE(max(seq), 0) + 1 FROM mcp.webhook_outbox WHERE run_id = :r"),
                {"r": run.run_id},
            )).scalar_one())
            event_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            target_task = task_id if task_id is not None else (str(run.task_id) if run.task_id else None)
            payload = {
                "contract_version": self.settings.dashboard.contract_version,
                "event_id": event_id,
                "event_type": event_type,
                "occurred_at": _iso(now()),
                "run_id": str(run.run_id),
                "agent_id": str(run.agent_id),
                "task_id": target_task,
                "data": clean,
            }
            row = WebhookOutbox(event_id=uuid.UUID(event_id), run_id=run.run_id, seq=seq,
                                event_type=event_type, payload=payload)
            session.add(row)
            run.last_event_at = now()
            await session.flush()
            emitted = EmittedEvent(id=row.id, event_id=event_id, seq=seq, run_id=str(run.run_id))
        self._wake.set()
        return emitted

    async def emit_and_wait(self, run_id: str, event_type: str, data: dict[str, Any], *,
                            task_id: str | None = None, timeout_s: float = 30.0) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Emit lalu tunggu respons Dashboard (`result` untuk peta subtask/conflict blok)."""
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        event = await self.emit(run_id, event_type, data, task_id=task_id)
        future = self._waiters.setdefault(event.event_id, loop.create_future())
        try:
            return await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(future), timeout=timeout_s)
        except TimeoutError:
            raise UpstreamTimeout(
                f"Webhook {event_type} belum terkirim dalam {int(timeout_s)} s (tetap di antrean)",
                details={"event_id": event.event_id},
            ) from None
        finally:
            self._waiters.pop(event.event_id, None)

    async def discard_run(self, run_id: str, reason: str = "run_not_active") -> int:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            result = await session.execute(
                update(WebhookOutbox)
                .where(WebhookOutbox.run_id == uuid.UUID(run_id),
                       WebhookOutbox.status.in_(("pending", "sending")))
                .values(status="discarded", last_error=reason)
                .returning(WebhookOutbox.event_id)
            )
            discarded = [str(r[0]) for r in result.all()]
        for event_id in discarded:
            self._resolve(event_id, error=RunNotActive("Run tidak aktif; event dibuang"))
        return len(discarded)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ sender
    def stop(self) -> None:
        self._stop.set()
        self._wake.set()

    async def run_sender(self) -> None:
        log.info("outbox.sender_start")
        while not self._stop.is_set():
            try:
                sent = await self.send_due()
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - loop sender tidak boleh mati
                log.exception("outbox.loop_error", error=type(exc).__name__)
                sent = 0
            if not sent:
                self._wake.clear()
                with contextlib.suppress(TimeoutError):
                    await asyncio.wait_for(self._wake.wait(), timeout=IDLE_POLL_S)
        log.info("outbox.sender_stopped")

    async def send_due(self) -> int:
        """Satu putaran: kirim kepala antrean setiap run yang jatuh tempo. Kembalikan jumlah dikirim."""
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            heads = (await session.execute(text(
                """
                SELECT DISTINCT ON (run_id) id, run_id, next_attempt_at <= now() AS due
                FROM mcp.webhook_outbox WHERE status IN ('pending', 'sending')
                ORDER BY run_id, seq
                """
            ))).all()
        OUTBOX_PENDING.set(len(heads))
        due = [h for h in heads if h.due and str(h.run_id) not in self._inflight]
        if not due:
            return 0
        results = await asyncio.gather(*(self._send_guarded(h.id, str(h.run_id)) for h in due))
        return sum(1 for r in results if r)

    async def _send_guarded(self, row_id: int, run_id: str) -> bool:
        self._inflight.add(run_id)
        try:
            async with self._sem:
                return await self._send(row_id)
        finally:
            self._inflight.discard(run_id)

    async def _target_url(self, row: WebhookOutbox) -> str:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            callback = await session.scalar(select(Run.callback).where(Run.run_id == row.run_id))
        url = (callback or {}).get("webhook_url")
        return str(url or f"{self.settings.dashboard.dashboard_api_url.rstrip('/')}/webhooks/mcp/events")

    async def _send(self, row_id: int) -> bool:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            row = await session.get(WebhookOutbox, row_id)
            if row is None or row.status not in ("pending", "sending"):
                return False
            row.status = "sending"
            row.attempts += 1
            if row.first_attempt_at is None:
                row.first_attempt_at = now()
            session.expunge(row)
        body = orjson.dumps(row.payload)
        headers = signer.signed_headers(self.settings.dashboard.mcp_webhook_secret.get_secret_value(), body)
        url = await self._target_url(row)
        started = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            resp = await self.http.post(url, content=body, headers=headers, timeout=SEND_TIMEOUT_S)
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            await self._retry_later(row, None, f"network: {type(exc).__name__}")
            return True
        finally:
            WEBHOOK_LATENCY.observe(time.perf_counter() - started)
        await self._handle_response(row, resp)
        return True

    async def _handle_response(self, row: WebhookOutbox, resp: httpx.Response) -> None:
        status = resp.status_code
        event_id = str(row.event_id)
        body: dict[str, Any] = {}
        with contextlib.suppress(ValueError):
            parsed = resp.json()
            body = parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {}
        error = body.get("error") if isinstance(body.get("error"), dict) else {}
        code = str(error.get("code") or "")
        message = truncate(str(error.get("message") or resp.reason_phrase), 500)

        if status == 200:
            dup = body.get("status") == "duplicate"
            result = body.get("result") if isinstance(body.get("result"), dict) else {}
            await self._finalize(row, "duplicate" if dup else "delivered", status, response=result,
                                 delivered=True)
            WEBHOOK_SENT.labels("duplicate" if dup else "delivered").inc()
            self._resolve(event_id, result={**result, "duplicate": True} if dup else result)
            return
        if status == 409 and code == "RUN_NOT_ACTIVE":
            await self._finalize(row, "discarded", status, error=message)
            discarded = await self.discard_run(str(row.run_id))
            WEBHOOK_SENT.labels("run_not_active").inc()
            log.warning("outbox.run_not_active", run_id=str(row.run_id), discarded=discarded)
            self._resolve(event_id, error=RunNotActive(f"Dashboard: {message}"))
            await self._mark_run_inactive(str(row.run_id))
            return
        if status == 429 or status >= 500:
            await self._retry_later(row, status, message)
            return

                    await asyncio.wait_for(self._wake.wait(), timeout=IDLE_POLL_S)
        log.info("outbox.sender_stopped")

    async def send_due(self) -> int:
        """Satu putaran: kirim kepala antrean setiap run yang jatuh tempo. Kembalikan jumlah dikirim."""
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            heads = (await session.execute(text(
                """
                SELECT DISTINCT ON (run_id) id, run_id, next_attempt_at <= now() AS due
                FROM mcp.webhook_outbox WHERE status IN ('pending', 'sending')
                ORDER BY run_id, seq
                """
            ))).all()
        OUTBOX_PENDING.set(len(heads))
        due = [h for h in heads if h.due and str(h.run_id) not in self._inflight]
        if not due:
            return 0
        results = await asyncio.gather(*(self._send_guarded(h.id, str(h.run_id)) for h in due))
        return sum(1 for r in results if r)

    async def _send_guarded(self, row_id: int, run_id: str) -> bool:
        self._inflight.add(run_id)
        try:
            async with self._sem:
                return await self._send(row_id)
        finally:
            self._inflight.discard(run_id)

    async def _target_url(self, row: WebhookOutbox) -> str:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            callback = await session.scalar(select(Run.callback).where(Run.run_id == row.run_id))
        url = (callback or {}).get("webhook_url")
        return str(url or f"{self.settings.dashboard.dashboard_api_url.rstrip('/')}/webhooks/mcp/events")

    async def _send(self, row_id: int) -> bool:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            row = await session.get(WebhookOutbox, row_id)
            if row is None or row.status not in ("pending", "sending"):
                return False
            row.status = "sending"
            row.attempts += 1
            if row.first_attempt_at is None:
                row.first_attempt_at = now()
            session.expunge(row)
        body = orjson.dumps(row.payload)
        headers = signer.signed_headers(self.settings.dashboard.mcp_webhook_secret.get_secret_value(), body)
        url = await self._target_url(row)
        started = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            resp = await self.http.post(url, content=body, headers=headers, timeout=SEND_TIMEOUT_S)
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            await self._retry_later(row, None, f"network: {type(exc).__name__}")
            return True
        finally:
            WEBHOOK_LATENCY.observe(time.perf_counter() - started)
        await self._handle_response(row, resp)
        return True

    async def _handle_response(self, row: WebhookOutbox, resp: httpx.Response) -> None:
        status = resp.status_code
        event_id = str(row.event_id)
        body: dict[str, Any] = {}
        with contextlib.suppress(ValueError):
            parsed = resp.json()
            body = parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {}
        error = body.get("error") if isinstance(body.get("error"), dict) else {}
        code = str(error.get("code") or "")
        message = truncate(str(error.get("message") or resp.reason_phrase), 500)

        if status == 200:
            dup = body.get("status") == "duplicate"
            result = body.get("result") if isinstance(body.get("result"), dict) else {}
            await self._finalize(row, "duplicate" if dup else "delivered", status, response=result,
                                 delivered=True)
            WEBHOOK_SENT.labels("duplicate" if dup else "delivered").inc()
            self._resolve(event_id, result={**result, "duplicate": True} if dup else result)
            return
        if status == 409 and code == "RUN_NOT_ACTIVE":
            await self._finalize(row, "discarded", status, error=message)
            discarded = await self.discard_run(str(row.run_id))
            WEBHOOK_SENT.labels("run_not_active").inc()
            log.warning("outbox.run_not_active", run_id=str(row.run_id), discarded=discarded)
            self._resolve(event_id, error=RunNotActive(f"Dashboard: {message}"))
            await self._mark_run_inactive(str(row.run_id))
            return
        if status == 429 or status >= 500:
            await self._retry_later(row, status, message)
            return
        # 400/401/404/422/409 lain: jangan retry
        await self._finalize(row, "failed", status, error=f"{code}: {message}")
        WEBHOOK_SENT.labels("rejected").inc()
        if status == 401:
            log.critical("outbox.signature_rejected", run_id=str(row.run_id),
                         hint="cek MCP_WEBHOOK_SECRET & jam server")
            err: ToolError = OutboxRejected("Signature webhook ditolak Dashboard", code="UPSTREAM_ERROR",
                                            retryable=False, details={"reason": "WEBHOOK_AUTH"})
        else:
            log.warning("outbox.rejected", status=status, code=code, event_type=row.event_type)
            err = OutboxRejected(f"Dashboard menolak {row.event_type} ({status} {code}): {message}",
                                 details={"status": status, "dashboard_code": code,
                                          "dashboard_details": error.get("details")})
        self._resolve(event_id, error=err)

    async def _retry_later(self, row: WebhookOutbox, status: int | None, error: str) -> None:
        first = row.first_attempt_at or now()
        limit = timedelta(minutes=self.settings.dashboard.webhook_max_retry_minutes)
        if now() - first > limit:
            await self._finalize(row, "failed", status, error=f"retry habis: {error}")
            WEBHOOK_SENT.labels("gave_up").inc()
            self._resolve(str(row.event_id), error=OutboxRejected(
                "Webhook gagal terkirim setelah batas retry", code="UPSTREAM_ERROR", retryable=False,
                details={"reason": "WEBHOOK_UNDELIVERABLE"}))
            return
        delay = min(MAX_BACKOFF_S, 2 ** max(0, row.attempts - 1))
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            await session.execute(
                update(WebhookOutbox).where(WebhookOutbox.id == row.id).values(
                    status="pending", attempts=row.attempts, first_attempt_at=first,
                    next_attempt_at=now() + timedelta(seconds=delay), last_http_status=status,
                    last_error=truncate(error, 500),
                )
            )
        WEBHOOK_SENT.labels("retry").inc()
        log.info("outbox.retry", status=status, delay_s=delay, event_type=row.event_type)

    async def _finalize(self, row: WebhookOutbox, status: str, http_status: int, *,
                        response: dict[str, Any] | None = None, error: str | None = None,
                        delivered: bool = False) -> None:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            await session.execute(
                update(WebhookOutbox).where(WebhookOutbox.id == row.id).values(
                    status=status, attempts=row.attempts, first_attempt_at=row.first_attempt_at,
                    last_http_status=http_status, response=response, last_error=error,
                    delivered_at=now() if delivered else None,
                )
            )

    async def _mark_run_inactive(self, run_id: str) -> None:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            await session.execute(
                update(Run).where(Run.run_id == uuid.UUID(run_id),
                                  Run.status.in_(("accepted", "running")))
                .values(status="cancelled_by_dashboard", cancel_requested=True,
                        cancel_reason="run_not_active", finished_at=now())
            )

    def _resolve(self, event_id: str, *, result: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
                 error: ToolError | None = None) -> None:
        future = self._waiters.get(event_id)
        if future is None or future.done():
            return
        if error is not None:
            future.set_exception(error)
        else:
            future.set_result(result or {})

"""Bangkitkan fixture payload kontrak (valid & invalid) ke tests/contract/fixtures/ (TASK-08).

    python scripts/export_contract_fixtures.py

Fixture valid dibangun lewat model Pydantic MCP (harus lolos Zod Dashboard); fixture invalid
dibangun mentah dan HARUS ditolak oleh validator MCP maupun Zod. Validasi Zod dijalankan oleh
`tests/contract/validate_with_zod.cjs` (memakai build `dist/` repo Dashboard).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import orjson

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from mcp_marketing.schemas.blocks import text_inline  # noqa: E402
from mcp_marketing.services.templates.md_to_blocks import markdown_to_blocks  # noqa: E402

OUT = ROOT / "tests" / "contract" / "fixtures"
RUN = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
AGENT = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
TASK = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
USER = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"

SAMPLE_MD = """## Ringkasan
Kalender konten **3 minggu** untuk [brand](https://example.com).

- Pilar: edukasi
- Pilar: promo

1. Riset
2. Produksi

- [ ] Draft minggu 1
- [x] Brief disetujui

> Catatan: hindari klaim berlebihan.

```python
print("halo")
```

| Minggu | Tema |
|---|---|
| 1 | Edukasi |
| 2 | Promo |

---
"""


def envelope(event_type: str, data: dict[str, Any], **over: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    env = {
        "contract_version": "1.0",
        "event_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
        "event_type": event_type,
        "occurred_at": "2026-11-03T03:15:00Z",
        "run_id": RUN,
        "agent_id": AGENT,
        "task_id": TASK,
        "data": data,
    }
    env.update(over)
    return env


def append(block_type: str, content_json: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"op": "append", "block": {"block_type": block_type, "content_json": content_json}}


def build() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    from mcp_marketing.schemas.contract import validate_event_data

    blocks = markdown_to_blocks(SAMPLE_MD)
    extra = [
        {"block_type": "image", "content_json": {"props": {"url": "https://example.com/a.png", "caption": "x"}}},
        {"block_type": "bookmark", "content_json": {"props": {"url": "https://example.com", "title": "Ref"}}},
        {"block_type": "aiPrompt", "content_json": {"props": {"prompt": "Buat ringkasan", "agent_id": AGENT}}},
        {"block_type": "toggleListItem", "content_json": {"content": [text_inline("Detail")]}},
        {"block_type": "paragraph", "content_json": {"content": [
            {"type": "mention", "props": {"mention_type": "user", "id": USER, "label": "Owner"}},
            text_inline(" tolong cek", italic=True)]}},
    ]
    ops = [{"op": "append", "block": b} for b in [*blocks, *extra]]
    valid_events = {
        "started": ("agent.task.started", {}),
        "status_working": ("agent.status.changed", {"status": "working", "message": "Membaca brief…"}),
        "block_appended_all_types": ("agent.block.appended", {"operations": ops}),
        "block_update": ("agent.block.appended", {"operations": [{
            "op": "update", "expected_version": 3,
            "block": {"id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "block_type": "paragraph",
                      "content_json": {"props": {}, "content": [text_inline("revisi")]}}}]}),
        "subtask_created": ("agent.subtask.created", {"subtasks": [
            {"client_ref": "week-1", "title": "Draft Week 1", "priority": "medium", "start_date": "2026-11-02",
             "end_date": "2026-11-03", "tags": ["content"], "assign_to_self": True,
             "initial_blocks": [{"block_type": "paragraph", "content_json": {"content": [text_inline("…")]}}]}]}),
        "comment_added": ("agent.comment.added", {"content": "Selesai, cek Week 1.",
                                                  "mentions": [{"type": "user", "id": USER}]}),
        "completed": ("agent.task.completed", {"summary": "Kalender 3 minggu dibuat."}),
        "failed": ("agent.task.failed", {"error_code": "BUDGET_EXCEEDED", "message": "Budget habis",
                                         "retryable": False}),
    }
    fixtures: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for name, (event_type, data) in valid_events.items():
        fixtures.append({"name": f"valid_{name}", "kind": "event", "valid": True,
                         "payload": envelope(event_type, validate_event_data(event_type, data))})

    invalid_events = {
        "ops_51": ("agent.block.appended", {"operations": [append("divider", {})] * 51}),
        "ops_empty": ("agent.block.appended", {"operations": []}),
        "heading_level_4": ("agent.block.appended", {"operations": [append("heading", {"props": {"level": 4}})]}),
        "image_javascript_url": ("agent.block.appended", {"operations": [
            append("image", {"props": {"url": "javascript:alert(1)"}})]}),
        "unknown_block_type": ("agent.block.appended", {"operations": [append("video", {})]}),
        "table_51_rows": ("agent.block.appended", {"operations": [append("table", {"content": {
            "type": "tableContent", "rows": [{"cells": [[text_inline("x")]]}] * 51}})]}),
        "bad_color": ("agent.block.appended", {"operations": [append("paragraph", {"props": {"textColor": "red;"}})]}),
        "subtasks_21": ("agent.subtask.created", {"subtasks": [{"title": f"T{i}"} for i in range(21)]}),
        "subtask_bad_date": ("agent.subtask.created", {"subtasks": [{"title": "T", "start_date": "2026-13-01"}]}),
        "subtask_empty_title": ("agent.subtask.created", {"subtasks": [{"title": "   "}]}),
        "comment_too_long": ("agent.comment.added", {"content": "x" * 10_001}),
        "status_idle": ("agent.status.changed", {"status": "idle"}),
        "failed_no_code": ("agent.task.failed", {"message": "x"}),
    }
    for name, (event_type, data) in invalid_events.items():
        fixtures.append({"name": f"invalid_{name}", "kind": "event", "valid": False,
                         "payload": envelope(event_type, data)})
    fixtures.append({"name": "invalid_contract_2", "kind": "event", "valid": False,
                     "payload": envelope("agent.task.started", {}, contract_version="2.0")})
    fixtures.append({"name": "invalid_event_type", "kind": "event", "valid": False,
                     "payload": envelope("agent.task.paused", {})})

    outputs = [
        ("valid_dispatch", "dispatch", {"accepted": True, "mcp_run_id": "mr_0123456789"}, True),
        ("valid_estimation", "estimation", {"start_date": "2026-11-03", "end_date": "2026-11-05",
                                            "estimated_days": 3, "confidence": 0.7, "message": "Siap."}, True),
        ("valid_cancel", "cancel", {"cancelled": True}, True),
        ("invalid_estimation_date", "estimation", {"start_date": "03-11-2026", "end_date": "2026-11-05"}, False),
        ("invalid_confidence", "estimation", {"start_date": "2026-11-03", "end_date": "2026-11-05",
                                              "confidence": 1.5}, False),
    ]
    for name, schema, payload, valid in outputs:
        fixtures.append({"name": name, "kind": "output", "schema": schema, "valid": valid, "payload": payload})
    return fixtures


def main() -> int:
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fixtures = build()
    for old in OUT.glob("*.json"):
        old.unlink()
    for f in fixtures:
        (OUT / f"{f['name']}.json").write_bytes(orjson.dumps(f, option=orjson.OPT_INDENT_2))
    print(f"{len(fixtures)} fixture ditulis ke {OUT}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

input.content:
"""Markdown ringkas -> blok BlockNote Dashboard (hemat token: LLM menulis markdown, bukan JSON blok).

Didukung: heading #..###, paragraf, bullet/numbered list, checklist `- [ ]`/`- [x]`, quote `>`,
code fence, tabel GFM, divider `---`, gambar `![alt](url)`, inline **bold** *italic* `code`
~~strike~~ [link](url). List bertingkat diratakan. Semua blok divalidasi `validate_block_content`.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Any

from mcp_marketing.schemas.blocks import (
    MAX_TABLE_COLS,
    MAX_TABLE_ROWS,
    BlockValidationError,
    is_safe_url,
    validate_block_content,
)

MAX_TEXT_PER_BLOCK = 9_000
_HEADING = re.compile(r"^(#{1,6})\s+(.*)$")
_CHECK = re.compile(r"^\s*[-*+]\s+\[([ xX])\]\s+(.*)$")
_BULLET = re.compile(r"^\s*[-*+]\s+(.*)$")
_NUMBERED = re.compile(r"^\s*(\d{1,6})[.)]\s+(.*)$")
_QUOTE = re.compile(r"^\s*>\s?(.*)$")
_FENCE = re.compile(r"^\s*(```|~~~)\s*([A-Za-z0-9+#._-]*)\s*$")
_DIVIDER = re.compile(r"^\s*(-{3,}|\*{3,}|_{3,})\s*$")
_IMAGE = re.compile(r"^\s*!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)\s*$")
_TABLE_ROW = re.compile(r"^\s*\|.*\|\s*$")
_TABLE_SEP = re.compile(r"^\s*\|?\s*:?-{2,}:?\s*(\|\s*:?-{2,}:?\s*)*\|?\s*$")
_INLINE = re.compile(
    r"\[(?P<ltext>[^\]]+)\]\((?P<href>[^)\s]+)\)"
    r"|\*\*(?P<bold>.+?)\*\*"
    r"|~~(?P<strike>.+?)~~"
    r"|`(?P<code>[^`]+)`"
    r"|(?<![\w*])\*(?P<italic>[^*\s][^*]*?)\*(?![\w*])"
    r"|(?<!\w)_(?P<italic2>[^_\s][^_]*?)_(?!\w)"
)


def _text(text: str, styles: dict[str, bool]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "text", "text": text, "styles": {k: v for k, v in styles.items() if v}}


def parse_inline(text: str, styles: dict[str, bool] | None = None, *, allow_links: bool = True) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    base = dict(styles or {})
    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    pos = 0
    for m in _INLINE.finditer(text):
        if m.start() > pos:
            out.append(_text(text[pos : m.start()], base))
        if m.group("ltext") is not None:
            href = m.group("href")
            inner = parse_inline(m.group("ltext"), base, allow_links=False)
            if allow_links and is_safe_url(href, True):
                out.append({"type": "link", "href": href, "content": [i for i in inner if i["type"] == "text"]})
            else:
                out.extend(inner)
        elif m.group("bold") is not None:
            out.extend(parse_inline(m.group("bold"), {**base, "bold": True}, allow_links=allow_links))
        elif m.group("strike") is not None:
            out.extend(parse_inline(m.group("strike"), {**base, "strike": True}, allow_links=allow_links))
        elif m.group("code") is not None:
            out.append(_text(m.group("code"), {**base, "code": True}))
        else:
            inner_text = m.group("italic") or m.group("italic2") or ""
            out.extend(parse_inline(inner_text, {**base, "italic": True}, allow_links=allow_links))
        pos = m.end()
    if pos < len(text):
        out.append(_text(text[pos:], base))
    return [i for i in out if i["type"] != "text" or i["text"]]


def _block(block_type: str, content: Any = None, **props: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    content_json: dict[str, Any] = {"props": props}
    if content is not None:
        content_json["content"] = content
    return {"block_type": block_type, "content_json": content_json}


def _split_long(text: str) -> list[str]:
    if len(text) <= MAX_TEXT_PER_BLOCK:
        return [text]
    parts, current = [], ""
    for sentence in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text):
        if current and len(current) + len(sentence) + 1 > MAX_TEXT_PER_BLOCK:
            parts.append(current)
            current = ""
        while len(sentence) > MAX_TEXT_PER_BLOCK:
            parts.append(sentence[:MAX_TEXT_PER_BLOCK])
            sentence = sentence[MAX_TEXT_PER_BLOCK:]
        current = f"{current} {sentence}".strip()
    if current:
        parts.append(current)
    return parts


def _cells(line: str) -> list[str]:
    stripped = line.strip().strip("|")
    return [c.strip() for c in re.split(r"(?<!\\)\|", stripped)]


def _table_blocks(header: list[str], rows: list[list[str]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    width = min(MAX_TABLE_COLS, max(len(header), *(len(r) for r in rows)) if rows else len(header))

    def row(cells: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        padded = (cells + [""] * width)[:width]
        return {"cells": [parse_inline(c) for c in padded]}

    blocks = []
    per_table = MAX_TABLE_ROWS - 1  # baris pertama = header
    for start in range(0, max(1, len(rows)), per_table):
        chunk = rows[start : start + per_table]
        content = {"type": "tableContent", "headerRows": 1, "rows": [row(header), *(row(r) for r in chunk)]}
        blocks.append(_block("table", content))
    return blocks


def markdown_to_blocks(markdown: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    lines = markdown.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n")
    blocks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    paragraph: list[str] = []

    def flush_paragraph() -> None:
        if paragraph:
            text = " ".join(p.strip() for p in paragraph).strip()
            for part in _split_long(text):
                blocks.append(_block("paragraph", parse_inline(part)))
            paragraph.clear()

    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        if not line.strip():
            flush_paragraph()
            i += 1
            continue
        fence = _FENCE.match(line)
        if fence:
            flush_paragraph()
            marker, language = fence.group(1), fence.group(2)
            code: list[str] = []
            i += 1
            while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].strip().startswith(marker):
                code.append(lines[i])
                i += 1
            i += 1
            props = {"language": language[:32]} if language else {}
            blocks.append(_block("codeBlock", [_text("\n".join(code)[:MAX_TEXT_PER_BLOCK], {})], **props))
            continue
        if _TABLE_ROW.match(line) and i + 1 < len(lines) and _TABLE_SEP.match(lines[i + 1]):
            flush_paragraph()
            header = _cells(line)
            rows: list[list[str]] = []
            i += 2
            while i < len(lines) and _TABLE_ROW.match(lines[i]):
                rows.append(_cells(lines[i]))
                i += 1
            blocks.extend(_table_blocks(header, rows))
            continue
        if _DIVIDER.match(line):
            flush_paragraph()
            blocks.append(_block("divider"))
            i += 1
            continue
        heading = _HEADING.match(line)
        if heading:
            flush_paragraph()
            level = min(3, len(heading.group(1)))
            blocks.append(_block("heading", parse_inline(heading.group(2).strip()), level=level))
            i += 1
            continue
        image = _IMAGE.match(line)
        if image and is_safe_url(image.group(2)):
            flush_paragraph()
            blocks.append(_block("image", None, url=image.group(2), caption=image.group(1)[:1000] or None))
            i += 1
            continue
        check = _CHECK.match(line)
        if check:
            flush_paragraph()
            blocks.append(_block("checkListItem", parse_inline(check.group(2).strip()),
                                 checked=check.group(1).lower() == "x"))
            i += 1
            continue
        bullet = _BULLET.match(line)
        if bullet:
            flush_paragraph()
            blocks.append(_block("bulletListItem", parse_inline(bullet.group(1).strip())))
            i += 1
            continue
        numbered = _NUMBERED.match(line)
        if numbered:
            flush_paragraph()
            blocks.append(_block("numberedListItem", parse_inline(numbered.group(2).strip())))
            i += 1
            continue
        quote = _QUOTE.match(line)
        if quote:
            flush_paragraph()
            quoted = [quote.group(1)]
            i += 1
            while i < len(lines) and _QUOTE.match(lines[i]):
                quoted.append(_QUOTE.match(lines[i]).group(1))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                i += 1
            blocks.append(_block("quote", parse_inline(" ".join(q.strip() for q in quoted).strip())))
            continue
        paragraph.append(line)
        i += 1
    flush_paragraph()
    return [_validated(b) for b in blocks]


def _validated(block: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    props = {k: v for k, v in block["content_json"].get("props", {}).items() if v is not None}
    raw = {**block["content_json"], "props": props}
    try:
        cleaned = validate_block_content(block["block_type"], raw)
    except BlockValidationError:
        # fallback aman: tampilkan sebagai paragraf teks polos
        text = _plain(block)
        cleaned = validate_block_content("paragraph", {"content": [_text(text[:MAX_TEXT_PER_BLOCK], {})]})
