"""TASK-08 (unit): signer setara Dashboard, schema blok & kontrak, chunker, Agent API client."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import httpx
import pytest
import respx

from mcp_marketing.core.config import get_settings
from mcp_marketing.core.errors import ToolError
from mcp_marketing.schemas.blocks import BlockValidationError, extract_plain_text, validate_block_content
from mcp_marketing.schemas.contract import (
    DispatchInput,
    EstimationOutput,
    is_supported_contract,
    validate_event_data,
)
from mcp_marketing.services.dashboard import signer
from mcp_marketing.services.dashboard.agent_api import AgentApiClient, outline_blocks
from mcp_marketing.services.dashboard.chunking import chain_append_ops, chunk_block_ops, chunk_subtasks
from mcp_marketing.services.templates.md_to_blocks import markdown_to_blocks, parse_inline

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
FIXTURES = ROOT / "tests" / "contract" / "fixtures"
SECRET = "test-webhook-secret-0123456789abcdefghij"


# ---------- signer ----------
def test_signature_matches_dashboard_vector() -> None:
    body = '{"event_id":"x","data":{"a":"café"}}'.encode()
    # dihitung dengan signMcpPayload() dari build Dashboard (crypto.util.js)
    expected = "sha256=265d521a48d4c407986337e0e14a6784daf061d9cca23568253ba54dad7bdde5"
    assert signer.sign(SECRET, "1762140000", body) == expected
    assert signer.verify([SECRET], "1762140000", expected, body, now=1762140100) == "ok"


def test_signature_verify_cases() -> None:
    body = b"{}"
    headers = signer.signed_headers(SECRET, body, now=1000)
    ts, sig = headers["X-MCP-Timestamp"], headers["X-MCP-Signature"]
    assert headers["Content-Type"] == "application/json"
    assert signer.verify(["old-secret", SECRET], ts, sig, body, now=1100) == "ok"
    assert signer.verify([SECRET], ts, sig, body, now=1400) == "expired"
    assert signer.verify(["lain"], ts, sig, body, now=1000) == "invalid"
    assert signer.verify([SECRET], None, sig, body) == "missing"
    assert signer.verify([SECRET], ts, sig, b"{ }", now=1000) == "invalid"


# ---------- blocks ----------
def test_block_strips_unknown_and_applies_defaults() -> None:
    out = validate_block_content("heading", {"props": {"foo": 1}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Hi\x07"}], "x": 2})
    assert out == {"props": {"level": 1}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Hi", "styles": {}}]}
    assert validate_block_content("checkListItem", {}) == {"props": {"checked": False}, "content": []}
    assert validate_block_content("divider", {"content": [1]}) == {"props": {}}
    assert validate_block_content("aiPrompt", None)["props"] == {"prompt": "", "status": "idle"}


@pytest.mark.parametrize("block_type,content", [
    ("heading", {"props": {"level": 4}}),
    ("image", {"props": {"url": "javascript:alert(1)"}}),
    ("paragraph", {"props": {"textColor": "red;"}}),
    ("paragraph", {"content": [{"type": "link", "href": "ftp://x", "content": []}]}),
    ("paragraph", {"content": [{"type": "mention", "props": {"mention_type": "user", "id": "bukan-uuid", "label": "a"}}]}),
    ("codeBlock", {"props": {"language": "py thon"}}),
    ("table", {"content": {"type": "tableContent", "rows": [{"cells": [[]] * 21}]}}),
    ("video", {}),
    ("paragraph", {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "x" * 10_001}]}),
])
def test_block_invalid(block_type: str, content: Any) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(BlockValidationError):
        validate_block_content(block_type, content)


def test_block_size_limit() -> None:
    big = {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "x" * 9_000} for _ in range(8)]}
    with pytest.raises(BlockValidationError, match="byte"):
        validate_block_content("paragraph", big)


def test_extract_plain_text_table_and_bookmark() -> None:
    table = validate_block_content("table", {"content": {"type": "tableContent", "rows": [
        {"cells": [[{"type": "text", "text": "a"}], {"type": "tableCell", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "b"}]}]}]}})
    assert extract_plain_text("table", table) == "a | b"
    bm = validate_block_content("bookmark", {"props": {"url": "https://x.id", "title": "T"}})
    assert extract_plain_text("bookmark", bm) == "T https://x.id"


# ---------- kontrak ----------
def test_contract_version_check() -> None:
    assert is_supported_contract("1.0") and is_supported_contract("1.12")
    assert not is_supported_contract("2.0") and not is_supported_contract("")


def test_dispatch_input_tolerates_extra_and_nulls() -> None:
    raw = json.loads((ROOT / "tests" / "contract" / "dispatch_sample.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    raw["future_field"] = {"x": 1}
    parsed = DispatchInput.model_validate(raw)
    assert parsed.task.title == "Generate Content Calendar"
    assert parsed.dispatched_by is None
    assert parsed.agent_id == parsed.agent_id.lower()


def test_estimation_output_bounds() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        EstimationOutput(start_date="2026-11-03", end_date="2026-11-04", confidence=2)


def test_event_data_validation_strips_none() -> None:
    out = validate_event_data("agent.task.failed", {"error_code": "X", "message": "m", "retryable": None})
    assert out == {"error_code": "X", "message": "m"}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_event_data("agent.comment.added", {"content": "  "})


@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", sorted(FIXTURES.glob("*.json")), ids=lambda p: p.stem)
def test_fixture_python_validator_agrees(path: Path) -> None:
    fx = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if fx["kind"] == "output":
        from mcp_marketing.schemas.contract import CancelOutput, DispatchOutput

        model = {"dispatch": DispatchOutput, "estimation": EstimationOutput, "cancel": CancelOutput}[fx["schema"]]
        call = lambda: model.model_validate(fx["payload"])  # noqa: E731
    else:
        from mcp_marketing.schemas.contract import WebhookEnvelope

        def call() -> Any:
            env = WebhookEnvelope.model_validate(fx["payload"])
            return validate_event_data(env.event_type, env.data)

    if fx["valid"]:
        call()
    else:
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            call()


@pytest.mark.contract
def test_fixtures_accepted_by_dashboard_zod() -> None:
    node = shutil.which("node") or r"D:\Data.Fahrul\Documents\PortableDev\node\node.exe"
    backend = ROOT.parent / "marketingdashboardjtp" / "backend"
    if not Path(node).exists() or not (backend / "dist" / "shared" / "schemas" / "mcp.schema.js").exists():
        pytest.skip("node atau build dist/ Dashboard tidak tersedia")
    proc = subprocess.run([node, str(ROOT / "tests" / "contract" / "validate_with_zod.cjs"), str(backend),
                           str(FIXTURES)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    results = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    mismatches = [r for r in results if r["expected"] != r["valid"]]
    assert results and mismatches == []


# ---------- chunking ----------
def test_chunk_block_ops_by_count_and_size() -> None:
    ops = [{"op": "append", "block": {"block_type": "divider"}}] * 120
    assert [len(c) for c in chunk_block_ops(ops)] == [50, 50, 20]
    big = [{"op": "append", "x": "y" * 400_000}] * 3
    assert [len(c) for c in chunk_block_ops(big)] == [2, 1]
    assert [len(c) for c in chunk_subtasks(list(range(45)))] == [20, 20, 5]


def test_chain_append_ops_after_prompt_block() -> None:
    ops = chain_append_ops([{"block_type": "divider"}, {"block_type": "divider"}], after_block_id="p1")
    assert ops[0]["after_block_id"] == "p1"
    assert ops[1]["after_block_id"] == ops[0]["block"]["id"]
    tail = chain_append_ops([{"block_type": "divider"}], after_block_id=None)
    assert "after_block_id" not in tail[0]


# ---------- md_to_blocks ----------
MD_CASES = [
    ("# Judul", ["heading"]),
    ("#### Sub dalam", ["heading"]),
    ("Paragraf biasa\nlanjut baris", ["paragraph"]),
    ("- a\n- b\n  - nested", ["bulletListItem"] * 3),
    ("1. satu\n2. dua", ["numberedListItem"] * 2),
    ("- [ ] todo\n- [x] done", ["checkListItem"] * 2),
    ("> kutipan\n> baris 2", ["quote"]),
    ("```js\nconst a = 1;\n```", ["codeBlock"]),
    ("| a | b |\n|---|---|\n| 1 | 2 |", ["table"]),
    ("---", ["divider"]),
    ("![logo](https://x.id/a.png)", ["image"]),
    ("![logo](javascript:x)", ["paragraph"]),
    ("**tebal** dan *miring* `kode` ~~coret~~", ["paragraph"]),
    ("[tautan](https://example.com) dan [jahat](javascript:alert)", ["paragraph"]),
    ("## H2\nteks\n\n- poin", ["heading", "paragraph", "bulletListItem"]),
    ("```\ntanpa bahasa\n```", ["codeBlock"]),
    ("x" * 20_000, ["paragraph", "paragraph", "paragraph"]),
    ("| h |\n|---|\n" + "\n".join(f"| {i} |" for i in range(120)), ["table"] * 3),
    ("", []),
    ("Teks _miring_ dan snake_case_var", ["paragraph"]),
]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("md,types", MD_CASES)
def test_md_to_blocks_types_and_valid(md: str, types: list[str]) -> None:
    blocks = markdown_to_blocks(md)
    assert [b["block_type"] for b in blocks] == types
    for b in blocks:
        assert validate_block_content(b["block_type"], b["content_json"]) == b["content_json"]


def test_md_inline_styles() -> None:
    inline = parse_inline("**tebal** *miring* `kode` [web](https://a.id)")
    assert inline[0] == {"type": "text", "text": "tebal", "styles": {"bold": True}}
    assert {"type": "text", "text": "miring", "styles": {"italic": True}} in inline
    assert {"type": "text", "text": "kode", "styles": {"code": True}} in inline
    assert inline[-1]["type"] == "link" and inline[-1]["href"] == "https://a.id"
    unsafe = parse_inline("[x](javascript:alert(1))")
    assert all(i["type"] == "text" for i in unsafe)
    snake = parse_inline("snake_case_var")
    assert snake == [{"type": "text", "text": "snake_case_var", "styles": {}}]
    check = markdown_to_blocks("- [x] selesai")[0]
    assert check["content_json"]["props"]["checked"] is True


# ---------- Agent API ----------
API = "http://dashboard.test/api/v1/agent-api/runs/r1"


@pytest.fixture
def api() -> AgentApiClient:
    return AgentApiClient(get_settings(), httpx.AsyncClient())


@respx.mock
async def test_agent_api_query_trims_and_sends_token(api: AgentApiClient) -> None:
    route = respx.post(f"{API}/context/query").mock(return_value=httpx.Response(200, json={"results": [
        {"block_id": "b1", "task_id": None, "task_title": None, "source": "project_brief", "block_type": "paragraph",
         "text": "x" * 2000, "rank": 0.4}]}))
    results = await api.query_context("r1", "tone", top_k=50)
    assert len(results[0]["text"]) == 600
    req = route.calls[0].request
    assert req.headers["authorization"] == "Bearer test-service-token-0123456789abcdefghijk"
    assert json.loads(req.content)["top_k"] == 20


@respx.mock
async def test_agent_api_task_outline(api: AgentApiClient) -> None:
    respx.get(f"{API}/tasks/t1").mock(return_value=httpx.Response(200, json={
        "task": {"id": "t1", "title": "T"},
        "blocks": [{"id": "b1", "block_type": "heading", "version": 1,
                    "content_json": {"props": {"level": 2}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Brief"}]},
                    "children": [{"id": "b2", "block_type": "paragraph", "version": 2,
                                  "content_json": {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "isi " * 400}]}, "children": []}]}],
        "subtasks": [],
        "comments": [{"id": f"c{i}", "content": "k", "author": {"type": "user", "name": "U"}} for i in range(50)],
    }))
    data = await api.get_task("r1", "t1")
    assert data["blocks"][0] == {"id": "b1", "type": "heading", "text": "Brief", "version": 1, "level": 2}
    assert data["blocks"][1]["depth"] == 1 and len(data["blocks"][1]["text"]) == 600
    assert len(data["comments"]) == 10 and data["comments"][-1]["id"] == "c49"


@respx.mock
@pytest.mark.parametrize("status,code,expected", [
    (409, "RUN_NOT_ACTIVE", "RUN_NOT_ACTIVE"),
    (404, "NOT_FOUND", "NOT_FOUND"),
    (429, "RATE_LIMITED", "RATE_LIMITED"),
    (500, "INTERNAL_ERROR", "UPSTREAM_ERROR"),
    (401, "UNAUTHENTICATED", "UPSTREAM_ERROR"),
])
async def test_agent_api_errors(api: AgentApiClient, status: int, code: str, expected: str) -> None:
    respx.get(API).mock(return_value=httpx.Response(status, json={"error": {"code": code, "message": "m"}}))
    with pytest.raises(ToolError) as exc:
        await api.get_run("r1")
    assert exc.value.code == expected


def test_outline_uses_plain_text_when_present() -> None:
    out = outline_blocks([{"id": "x", "block_type": "paragraph", "plain_text": "teks", "children": []}])
    assert out == [{"id": "x", "type": "paragraph", "text": "teks", "version": None}]

"""TASK-08: outbox webhook — urutan per run, retry, 409 discard, restart, emit_and_wait, signature."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any

import httpx
import pytest
from sqlalchemy import select, update

from mcp_marketing.core.errors import ToolError
from mcp_marketing.models import Run, WebhookOutbox
from mcp_marketing.server.services import Services
from mcp_marketing.services.dashboard import signer
from mcp_marketing.services.dashboard.outbox import Outbox
from mcp_marketing.services.seed import seed

WEBHOOK = "http://dashboard.test/api/v1/webhooks/mcp/events"


@dataclass
class FakeDashboard:
    """Penerima webhook palsu: verifikasi signature + antrean respons per panggilan."""

    secret: str
    responses: list[Callable[[dict[str, Any]], httpx.Response]] = field(default_factory=list)
    received: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    processed: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)

    def handler(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        body = request.content
        check = signer.verify([self.secret], request.headers.get("x-mcp-timestamp"),
                              request.headers.get("x-mcp-signature"), body)
        if check != "ok":
            return httpx.Response(401, json={"error": {"code": "INVALID_SIGNATURE", "message": check}})
        payload = json.loads(body)
        self.received.append(payload)
        if self.responses:
            return self.responses.pop(0)(payload)
        return self.default(payload)

    def default(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> httpx.Response:
        if payload["event_id"] in self.processed:
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"status": "duplicate"})
        self.processed.add(payload["event_id"])
        result: dict[str, Any] = {}
        if payload["event_type"] == "agent.subtask.created":
            result = {"created": [{"client_ref": s.get("client_ref"), "id": str(uuid.uuid4())}
                                  for s in payload["data"]["subtasks"]]}
        if payload["event_type"] == "agent.comment.added":
            result = {"comment_id": str(uuid.uuid4())}
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"status": "processed", "result": result})

    def client(self) -> httpx.AsyncClient:
        return httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(self.handler))


def status(code: int, err: str = "X") -> Callable[[dict[str, Any]], httpx.Response]:
    return lambda _p: httpx.Response(code, json={"error": {"code": err, "message": err}})


async def make_run(services: Services, **over: Any) -> str:
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        await seed(s)
    run_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        s.add(Run(run_id=uuid.UUID(run_id), mcp_run_id=f"mr_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}", trigger="assignment",
                  agent_key="strategist", agent_id=uuid.uuid4(), project_id=uuid.uuid4(), task_id=uuid.uuid4(),
                  status="running", input={}, callback={"webhook_url": WEBHOOK, "agent_api_base_url": "x"},
                  token_budget=1000, **over))
    return run_id


@pytest.fixture
def dashboard(services: Services) -> FakeDashboard:
    return FakeDashboard(secret=services.settings.dashboard.mcp_webhook_secret.get_secret_value())


@pytest.fixture
def outbox(services: Services, dashboard: FakeDashboard) -> Outbox:
    return Outbox(services.db, dashboard.client(), services.settings)


async def _rows(services: Services, run_id: str) -> list[WebhookOutbox]:
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        return list((await s.scalars(select(WebhookOutbox).where(WebhookOutbox.run_id == uuid.UUID(run_id))
                                     .order_by(WebhookOutbox.seq))).all())


async def _drain(outbox: Outbox, rounds: int = 20) -> None:
    for _ in range(rounds):
        if not await outbox.send_due():
            return

    b = await outbox.emit(run_id, "agent.status.changed", {"status": "working", "message": "Membaca brief"})
    assert (a.seq, b.seq) == (1, 2)
    await _drain(outbox)
    assert [p["event_type"] for p in dashboard.received] == ["agent.task.started", "agent.status.changed"]
    env = dashboard.received[0]
    assert env["contract_version"] == "1.0" and env["run_id"] == run_id and env["occurred_at"].endswith("Z")
    assert env["task_id"] is not None
    assert [r.status for r in await _rows(services, run_id)] == ["delivered", "delivered"]


async def test_invalid_event_data_rejected_before_queue(services: Services, outbox: Outbox) -> None:
    run_id = await make_run(services)
    with pytest.raises(ToolError) as exc:
        await outbox.emit(run_id, "agent.status.changed", {"status": "idle"})
    assert exc.value.code == "VALIDATION_ERROR"
    assert await _rows(services, run_id) == []


async def test_retry_500_500_200_same_event_id(services: Services, outbox: Outbox, dashboard: FakeDashboard) -> None:
    run_id = await make_run(services)
    dashboard.responses = [status(500), status(503)]
    await outbox.emit(run_id, "agent.task.started", {})
    for _ in range(3):
        await outbox.send_due()
        async with services.db.session() as s:  # lewati backoff
            await s.execute(update(WebhookOutbox).values(next_attempt_at=datetime.now(UTC)))
    rows = await _rows(services, run_id)
    assert rows[0].status == "delivered" and rows[0].attempts == 3
    assert len({p["event_id"] for p in dashboard.received}) == 1 and len(dashboard.received) == 3


async def test_seq2_waits_while_seq1_in_backoff(services: Services, outbox: Outbox, dashboard: FakeDashboard) -> None:
    run_id = await make_run(services)
    other_run = await make_run(services)
    dashboard.responses = [status(500)]
    await outbox.emit(run_id, "agent.task.started", {})
    await outbox.emit(run_id, "agent.status.changed", {"status": "working"})
    await outbox.send_due()  # seq1 -> 500 (backoff)
    await outbox.emit(other_run, "agent.task.started", {})
    await outbox.send_due()
    await outbox.send_due()
    sent = [(p["run_id"], p["event_type"]) for p in dashboard.received]
    assert (run_id, "agent.status.changed") not in sent  # seq2 tidak mendahului seq1

    assert [r.status for r in rows] == ["pending", "pending"] and rows[0].attempts == 1


async def test_409_run_not_active_discards_all_pending(services: Services, outbox: Outbox,
                                                       dashboard: FakeDashboard) -> None:
    run_id = await make_run(services)
    dashboard.responses = [status(409, "RUN_NOT_ACTIVE")]
    for i in range(3):
        await outbox.emit(run_id, "agent.status.changed", {"status": "working", "message": f"m{i}"})
    await _drain(outbox)
    assert [r.status for r in await _rows(services, run_id)] == ["discarded"] * 3
    assert len(dashboard.received) == 1

        await outbox.emit(run_id, "agent.task.started", {})
    assert exc.value.code == "RUN_NOT_ACTIVE"
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        run = await s.get(Run, uuid.UUID(run_id))
    assert run is not None and run.status == "cancelled_by_dashboard"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("code,expected_status", [(400, "failed"), (422, "failed"), (404, "failed"), (401, "failed")])
async def test_non_retryable_responses(services: Services, outbox: Outbox, dashboard: FakeDashboard,
                                       code: int, expected_status: str) -> None:
    run_id = await make_run(services)
    dashboard.responses = [status(code, "VALIDATION_ERROR")]
    await outbox.emit(run_id, "agent.task.started", {})
    await _drain(outbox)
    rows = await _rows(services, run_id)
    assert rows[0].status == expected_status and rows[0].last_http_status == code
    assert len(dashboard.received) == 1


async def test_wrong_secret_gets_401(services: Services, dashboard: FakeDashboard) -> None:
    run_id = await make_run(services)
    dashboard.secret = "secret-lain-yang-dipakai-dashboard-xxxxxxxx"
    outbox = Outbox(services.db, dashboard.client(), services.settings)
    await outbox.emit(run_id, "agent.task.started", {})
    await _drain(outbox)
    assert (await _rows(services, run_id))[0].last_http_status == 401


async def test_gives_up_after_max_retry_window(services: Services, outbox: Outbox, dashboard: FakeDashboard) -> None:
    run_id = await make_run(services)
    dashboard.responses = [status(502)]
    await outbox.emit(run_id, "agent.task.started", {})
    async with services.db.session() as s:
        await s.execute(update(WebhookOutbox).values(first_attempt_at=datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(minutes=31)))
    await outbox.send_due()
    assert (await _rows(services, run_id))[0].status == "failed"


async def test_restart_with_pending_events_delivers_in_order(services: Services, dashboard: FakeDashboard) -> None:
    run_id = await make_run(services)
    first = Outbox(services.db, dashboard.client(), services.settings)
    for i in range(5):
        await first.emit(run_id, "agent.status.changed", {"status": "working", "message": f"langkah {i}"})
    async with services.db.session() as s:  # simulasi crash saat mengirim seq 1
        await s.execute(update(WebhookOutbox).where(WebhookOutbox.seq == 1).values(status="sending"))
    restarted = Outbox(services.db, dashboard.client(), services.settings)
    await _drain(restarted)
    assert [p["data"]["message"] for p in dashboard.received] == [f"langkah {i}" for i in range(5)]
    assert {r.status for r in await _rows(services, run_id)} == {"delivered"}


async def test_dashboard_down_10_minutes_then_up(services: Services, outbox: Outbox, dashboard: FakeDashboard) -> None:
    run_id = await make_run(services)
    dashboard.responses = [status(503)] * 6

        await outbox.emit(run_id, "agent.status.changed", {"status": "working", "message": str(i)})
    for _ in range(12):

        async with services.db.session() as s:

async def test_emit_and_wait_returns_dashboard_result(services: Services, outbox: Outbox) -> None:
    run_id = await make_run(services)
    sender = asyncio.create_task(outbox.run_sender())
    try:
        result = await outbox.emit_and_wait(run_id, "agent.subtask.created", {

        await sender

    responses: list[Callable[[dict[str, Any]], httpx.Response]] = field(default_factory=list)
    received: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    processed: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)

    def handler(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        body = request.content
        check = signer.verify([self.secret], request.headers.get("x-mcp-timestamp"),
                              request.headers.get("x-mcp-signature"), body)
        if check != "ok":
            return httpx.Response(401, json={"error": {"code": "INVALID_SIGNATURE", "message": check}})
        payload = json.loads(body)
        self.received.append(payload)
        if self.responses:
            return self.responses.pop(0)(payload)
        return self.default(payload)

    def default(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> httpx.Response:
        if payload["event_id"] in self.processed:
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"status": "duplicate"})
        self.processed.add(payload["event_id"])

        if payload["event_type"] == "agent.subtask.created":

        if payload["event_type"] == "agent.comment.added":
            result = {"comment_id": str(uuid.uuid4())}
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"status": "processed", "result": result})

    def client(self) -> httpx.AsyncClient:
        return httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(self.handler))

"""Registry run Dashboard di sisi MCP (`mcp.runs`): idempotensi dispatch, batas mention, pembatalan."""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any

import orjson
from sqlalchemy import func, select, update

from mcp_marketing.core.database import Database
from mcp_marketing.core.errors import Conflict, RateLimited
from mcp_marketing.core.logging import get_logger
from mcp_marketing.core.metrics import RUNS_TOTAL
from mcp_marketing.models import AgentProfile, Run
from mcp_marketing.schemas.contract import (
    ContextBlock,
    DispatchInput,
    MentionInput,
    PromptBlockInput,
)
from mcp_marketing.utils.ids import new_mcp_run_id
from mcp_marketing.utils.text import truncate
from mcp_marketing.utils.time import now

log = get_logger(__name__)

ACTIVE = ("accepted", "running")
TERMINAL = ("completed", "failed", "cancelled", "cancelled_by_dashboard")
MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 100_000
MENTION_LIMIT_PER_HOUR = 10
CONTEXT_TEXT_MAX = 400
THREAD_KEEP = 10
THREAD_TEXT_MAX = 1_000

RunInput = DispatchInput | MentionInput | PromptBlockInput


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AcceptResult:
    run_id: str
    mcp_run_id: str
    created: bool


def compact_context(blocks: list[ContextBlock], budget_bytes: int = 60_000) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """context_blocks -> outline teks (id, tipe, teks ≤ 400 char), dibatasi ukuran."""
    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    size = 0
    for b in blocks:
        item: dict[str, Any] = {"id": b.id, "type": b.block_type, "text": truncate(b.plain_text, CONTEXT_TEXT_MAX)}
        if b.block_type == "heading" and isinstance(b.content_json, dict):
            item["level"] = (b.content_json.get("props") or {}).get("level", 1)
        if b.parent_block_id:
            item["parent"] = b.parent_block_id
        size += len(orjson.dumps(item))
        if size > budget_bytes:
            break
        out.append(item)
    return out


def stored_input(trigger: str, inp: RunInput) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Input run yang disimpan (dipangkas; maks 100 KB)."""
    base: dict[str, Any] = {
        "trigger": trigger,
        "contract_version": inp.contract_version,
        "agent_key": inp.agent_key,
        "context": compact_context(inp.context_blocks),
    }
    task = getattr(inp, "task", None)
    if task is not None:
        base["task"] = task.model_dump(mode="json")
    if isinstance(inp, DispatchInput):
        base["description"] = truncate(inp.task_description, 4_000)
        base["subtasks"] = [s.model_dump(mode="json") for s in inp.subtasks[:50]]
        base["dispatched_by"] = inp.dispatched_by.model_dump(mode="json") if inp.dispatched_by else None
    elif isinstance(inp, MentionInput):
        base["comment"] = {**inp.comment.model_dump(mode="json"),
                           "content": truncate(inp.comment.content, THREAD_TEXT_MAX)}
        base["thread"] = [
            {**t.model_dump(mode="json"), "content": truncate(t.content, THREAD_TEXT_MAX)}
            for t in inp.thread[-THREAD_KEEP:]
        ]
    elif isinstance(inp, PromptBlockInput):
        base["prompt_block"] = inp.prompt_block.model_dump(mode="json")
    while len(orjson.dumps(base)) > MAX_INPUT_BYTES and base["context"]:
        base["context"] = base["context"][: len(base["context"]) // 2]
    return base


class RunRegistry:
    def __init__(self, db: Database) -> None:
        self.db = db

    async def accept(self, trigger: str, inp: RunInput, profile: AgentProfile) -> AcceptResult:
        run_uuid = uuid.UUID(inp.run_id)
        task = getattr(inp, "task", None)
        project_id = task.project_id if task is not None else getattr(inp, "project_id", None)
        task_id = task.id if task is not None else None
        workspace_id = task.workspace_id if task is not None else None
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            existing = await session.scalar(select(Run).where(Run.run_id == run_uuid).with_for_update())
            if existing is not None:
                if existing.status in ACTIVE:
                    return AcceptResult(str(existing.run_id), existing.mcp_run_id, created=False)
                raise Conflict(f"Run {inp.run_id} sudah {existing.status}; buat run baru", retryable=False)
            if trigger == "mention":
                await self._check_mention_rate(session, task_id or project_id)
            run = Run(
                run_id=run_uuid,
                mcp_run_id=new_mcp_run_id(),
                trigger=trigger,
                agent_key=profile.agent_key,
                agent_id=uuid.UUID(inp.agent_id),
                workspace_id=uuid.UUID(workspace_id) if workspace_id else None,
                project_id=uuid.UUID(str(project_id)),
                task_id=uuid.UUID(task_id) if task_id else None,
                status="accepted",
                input=stored_input(trigger, inp),
                callback=inp.callback.model_dump(mode="json"),
                token_budget=profile.run_token_budget,
            )
            session.add(run)
        RUNS_TOTAL.labels(trigger, "accepted").inc()
        log.info("run.accepted", run_id=inp.run_id, trigger=trigger, agent_key=profile.agent_key)
        return AcceptResult(inp.run_id, run.mcp_run_id, created=True)

    @staticmethod
    async def _check_mention_rate(session: Any, scope_id: str | None) -> None:
        if not scope_id:
            return
        target = uuid.UUID(scope_id)
        since = now() - timedelta(hours=1)
        count = await session.scalar(
            select(func.count()).select_from(Run).where(
                Run.trigger == "mention",
                Run.created_at >= since,
                (Run.task_id == target) | ((Run.task_id.is_(None)) & (Run.project_id == target)),
            )
        )
        if (count or 0) >= MENTION_LIMIT_PER_HOUR:
            raise RateLimited(f"Maksimal {MENTION_LIMIT_PER_HOUR} run mention per task per jam",
                              details={"limit": MENTION_LIMIT_PER_HOUR})

    async def get(self, run_id: str) -> Run | None:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            return await session.get(Run, uuid.UUID(run_id))

    async def mark_cancelled(self, run_id: str, reason: str) -> bool:
        """True bila run dikenal (aktif maupun tidak)."""
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            run = await session.get(Run, uuid.UUID(run_id))
            if run is None:
                return False
            run.cancel_requested = True
            run.cancel_reason = reason[:32]
            if run.status in ACTIVE:
                run.status = "cancelled"
                run.finished_at = now()
                RUNS_TOTAL.labels(run.trigger, "cancelled").inc()
        return True

    async def update(self, run_id: str, **values: Any) -> None:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            await session.execute(update(Run).where(Run.run_id == uuid.UUID(run_id)).values(**values))

"""Estimasi durasi task (pm_request_agent_estimation, kontrak §3.2): heuristik + satu panggilan LLM `fast`.

Hasil LLM dibatasi 0,5×–2× heuristik; kalender hanya hari kerja Senin–Jumat mulai
`earliest_start_date` (zona input). LLM gagal/lambat -> hasil heuristik confidence ≤ 0,4.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import math
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from mcp_marketing.core.errors import ToolError
from mcp_marketing.core.logging import get_logger
from mcp_marketing.schemas.contract import EstimationInput, EstimationOutput
from mcp_marketing.services.agent.budget import BudgetScope
from mcp_marketing.services.llm import prompts
from mcp_marketing.utils.text import truncate
from mcp_marketing.utils.time import add_workdays, next_workday

log = get_logger(__name__)

LLM_TIMEOUT_S = 20.0
FALLBACK_CONFIDENCE = 0.4
DESCRIPTION_CHARS = 1_500
MIN_DAYS = 0.5
MAX_DAYS = 60.0
_RESEARCH = re.compile(r"\b(riset|research|analisis|analisa|analysis|survei|survey|kompetitor)\b", re.I)
_REPORT = re.compile(r"\b(laporan|report|reporting)\b", re.I)
_CALENDAR = re.compile(r"\b(kalender|calendar|konten mingguan|weekly content)\b", re.I)
_WEEKS = re.compile(r"(\d{1,2})\s*(minggu|week|pekan)", re.I)


class LlmEstimate(BaseModel):
    estimated_days: float = Field(ge=0)
    confidence: float = Field(default=0.6, ge=0, le=1)
    message: str = Field(default="", max_length=400)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Heuristic:
    days: float
    reasons: tuple[str, ...]


def round_half(value: float) -> float:
    return max(MIN_DAYS, min(MAX_DAYS, math.ceil(value * 2) / 2))


def heuristic(title: str, description: str, subtask_count: int = 0) -> Heuristic:
    text = f"{title}\n{description}"
    days = 1.0
    reasons = ["basis 1 hari"]
    if subtask_count:
        days += 0.5 * subtask_count
        reasons.append(f"{subtask_count} subtask")
    extra = len(description) // DESCRIPTION_CHARS
    if extra:
        days += extra
        reasons.append(f"deskripsi {len(description)} karakter")
    if _RESEARCH.search(text):
        days += 1
        reasons.append("riset/analisis")
    if _CALENDAR.search(text):
        weeks = max((int(m.group(1)) for m in _WEEKS.finditer(text)), default=1)
        days += weeks
        reasons.append(f"kalender {weeks} minggu")
    if _REPORT.search(text):
        days += 1
        reasons.append("laporan")
    return Heuristic(round_half(days), tuple(reasons))


def schedule(earliest: date, estimated_days: float) -> tuple[date, date]:
    start = next_workday(earliest)
    end = add_workdays(start, max(1, math.ceil(estimated_days)))
    return start, end


def _generic_message(days: float) -> str:
    shown = int(days) if days == int(days) else days
    return f"Saya akan mengerjakan task ini. Estimasi selesai {shown} hari kerja."


async def estimate(inp: EstimationInput, llm: object | None, *, budget: BudgetScope | None = None,
                   timeout_s: float = LLM_TIMEOUT_S) -> tuple[EstimationOutput, int]:
    """Kembalikan `(output, llm_tokens)`."""
    description = inp.task_description or ""
    h = heuristic(inp.task.title, description)
    earliest = date.fromisoformat(inp.earliest_start_date)
    days, confidence, message, tokens = h.days, FALLBACK_CONFIDENCE, _generic_message(h.days), 0
    if llm is not None:
        prompt = prompts.render(
            "estimate",
            title=truncate(inp.task.title, 300),
            description=truncate(description, DESCRIPTION_CHARS) or "-",
            subtasks="-",
            heuristic_days=h.days,
        )
        try:
            parsed, result = await asyncio.wait_for(
                llm.chat_json("estimate", [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}], LlmEstimate,  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                              budget=budget, prompt_version="v1"),
                timeout=timeout_s,
            )
            tokens = result.total_tokens
            days = round_half(min(max(parsed.estimated_days, h.days * 0.5), h.days * 2))
            confidence = min(1.0, max(0.0, parsed.confidence))
            message = truncate(parsed.message.strip(), 200) or _generic_message(days)
        except (ToolError, TimeoutError) as exc:
            log.info("estimate.llm_fallback", reason=getattr(exc, "code", "TIMEOUT"))
    start, end = schedule(earliest, days)
    output = EstimationOutput(
        start_date=start.isoformat(), end_date=end.isoformat(), estimated_days=days,
        confidence=round(confidence, 2), message=message,
    )
    return output, tokens

"""Registry run Dashboard di sisi MCP (`mcp.runs`): idempotensi dispatch, batas mention, pembatalan."""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any

import orjson
from sqlalchemy import func, select, update

from mcp_marketing.core.database import Database
from mcp_marketing.core.errors import Conflict, RateLimited
from mcp_marketing.core.logging import get_logger
from mcp_marketing.core.metrics import RUNS_TOTAL
from mcp_marketing.models import AgentProfile, Run
from mcp_marketing.schemas.contract import (
    ContextBlock,
    DispatchInput,
    MentionInput,
    PromptBlockInput,
)
from mcp_marketing.utils.ids import new_mcp_run_id
from mcp_marketing.utils.text import truncate
from mcp_marketing.utils.time import now

log = get_logger(__name__)

ACTIVE = ("accepted", "running")
TERMINAL = ("completed", "failed", "cancelled", "cancelled_by_dashboard")
MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 100_000
MENTION_LIMIT_PER_HOUR = 10
CONTEXT_TEXT_MAX = 400
THREAD_KEEP = 10
THREAD_TEXT_MAX = 1_000

RunInput = DispatchInput | MentionInput | PromptBlockInput


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AcceptResult:
    run_id: str
    mcp_run_id: str
    created: bool


def compact_context(blocks: list[ContextBlock], budget_bytes: int = 60_000) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """context_blocks -> outline teks (id, tipe, teks ≤ 400 char), dibatasi ukuran."""
    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    size = 0
    for b in blocks:
        item: dict[str, Any] = {"id": b.id, "type": b.block_type, "text": truncate(b.plain_text, CONTEXT_TEXT_MAX)}
        if b.block_type == "heading" and isinstance(b.content_json, dict):
            item["level"] = (b.content_json.get("props") or {}).get("level", 1)
        if b.parent_block_id:
            item["parent"] = b.parent_block_id
        size += len(orjson.dumps(item))
        if size > budget_bytes:
            break
        out.append(item)
    return out


def stored_input(trigger: str, inp: RunInput) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Input run yang disimpan (dipangkas; maks 100 KB)."""
    base: dict[str, Any] = {
        "trigger": trigger,
        "contract_version": inp.contract_version,
        "agent_key": inp.agent_key,
        "context": compact_context(inp.context_blocks),
    }
    task = getattr(inp, "task", None)
    if task is not None:
        base["task"] = task.model_dump(mode="json")
    if isinstance(inp, DispatchInput):
        base["description"] = truncate(inp.task_description, 4_000)
        base["subtasks"] = [s.model_dump(mode="json") for s in inp.subtasks[:50]]
        base["dispatched_by"] = inp.dispatched_by.model_dump(mode="json") if inp.dispatched_by else None
    elif isinstance(inp, MentionInput):
        base["comment"] = {**inp.comment.model_dump(mode="json"),
                           "content": truncate(inp.comment.content, THREAD_TEXT_MAX)}
        base["thread"] = [
            {**t.model_dump(mode="json"), "content": truncate(t.content, THREAD_TEXT_MAX)}
            for t in inp.thread[-THREAD_KEEP:]
        ]
    elif isinstance(inp, PromptBlockInput):
        base["prompt_block"] = inp.prompt_block.model_dump(mode="json")
    while len(orjson.dumps(base)) > MAX_INPUT_BYTES and base["context"]:
        base["context"] = base["context"][: len(base["context"]) // 2]
    return base


class RunRegistry:
    def __init__(self, db: Database) -> None:
        self.db = db

    async def accept(self, trigger: str, inp: RunInput, profile: AgentProfile) -> AcceptResult:
        run_uuid = uuid.UUID(inp.run_id)
        task = getattr(inp, "task", None)
        project_id = task.project_id if task is not None else getattr(inp, "project_id", None)
        task_id = task.id if task is not None else None
        workspace_id = task.workspace_id if task is not None else None
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            existing = await session.scalar(select(Run).where(Run.run_id == run_uuid).with_for_update())
            if existing is not None:
                if existing.status in ACTIVE:
                    return AcceptResult(str(existing.run_id), existing.mcp_run_id, created=False)
                raise Conflict(f"Run {inp.run_id} sudah {existing.status}; buat run baru", retryable=False)
            if trigger == "mention":
                await self._check_mention_rate(session, task_id or project_id)
            run = Run(
                run_id=run_uuid,
                mcp_run_id=new_mcp_run_id(),
                trigger=trigger,
                agent_key=profile.agent_key,
                agent_id=uuid.UUID(inp.agent_id),
                workspace_id=uuid.UUID(workspace_id) if workspace_id else None,
                project_id=uuid.UUID(str(project_id)),
                task_id=uuid.UUID(task_id) if task_id else None,
                status="accepted",
                input=stored_input(trigger, inp),
                callback=inp.callback.model_dump(mode="json"),
                token_budget=profile.run_token_budget,
            )
            session.add(run)
        RUNS_TOTAL.labels(trigger, "accepted").inc()
        log.info("run.accepted", run_id=inp.run_id, trigger=trigger, agent_key=profile.agent_key)
        return AcceptResult(inp.run_id, run.mcp_run_id, created=True)

    @staticmethod
    async def _check_mention_rate(session: Any, scope_id: str | None) -> None:
        if not scope_id:
            return
        target = uuid.UUID(scope_id)
        since = now() - timedelta(hours=1)
        count = await session.scalar(
            select(func.count()).select_from(Run).where(
                Run.trigger == "mention",
                Run.created_at >= since,
                (Run.task_id == target) | ((Run.task_id.is_(None)) & (Run.project_id == target)),
            )
        )
        if (count or 0) >= MENTION_LIMIT_PER_HOUR:
            raise RateLimited(f"Maksimal {MENTION_LIMIT_PER_HOUR} run mention per task per jam",
                              details={"limit": MENTION_LIMIT_PER_HOUR})

    async def get(self, run_id: str) -> Run | None:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            return await session.get(Run, uuid.UUID(run_id))

    async def mark_cancelled(self, run_id: str, reason: str) -> bool:
        """True bila run dikenal (aktif maupun tidak)."""
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            run = await session.get(Run, uuid.UUID(run_id))
            if run is None:
                return False
            run.cancel_requested = True
            run.cancel_reason = reason[:32]
            if run.status in ACTIVE:
                run.status = "cancelled"
                run.finished_at = now()
                RUNS_TOTAL.labels(run.trigger, "cancelled").inc()
        return True

    async def update(self, run_id: str, **values: Any) -> None:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            await session.execute(update(Run).where(Run.run_id == uuid.UUID(run_id)).values(**values))

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from mcp_marketing.core.errors import Forbidden, ValidationFailed
from mcp_marketing.models import Run
from mcp_marketing.schemas.common import ToolInput
from mcp_marketing.server.registry import ToolContext, tool


class ContextQueryIn(ToolInput):
    query: str = Field(default="", max_length=500, description="Kata kunci; kosong = blok Project Brief")
    scope: Literal["project", "task"] = "project"
    top_k: int = Field(default=6, ge=1, le=20)


class ContextHit(BaseModel):
    block_id: str | None = None
    task_title: str | None = None
    source: str | None = None
    text: str
    rank: float | None = None


class ContextQueryOut(BaseModel):
    summary: str
    results: list[ContextHit]


@tool(
    name="pm_query_project_context",
    toolset="pm_agent",
    summary="Cari konteks project/task di Dashboard (full-text)",
    description="Search the Dashboard project (or current task subtree) for relevant document blocks. "
    "Empty query returns the Project Brief. Text is truncated to 600 chars per result.",
    input_model=ContextQueryIn,
    output_model=ContextQueryOut,
    agent_only=True,
)
async def pm_query_project_context(inp: ContextQueryIn, ctx: ToolContext) -> ContextQueryOut:
    if not ctx.run_id:
        raise Forbidden("pm_query_project_context hanya tersedia di dalam agent run")
    if ctx.services.agent_api is None:
        raise ValidationFailed("Agent API Dashboard tidak dikonfigurasi")
    async with ctx.services.db.session() as session:
        run = await session.get(Run, uuid.UUID(ctx.run_id))
    if run is None:
        raise Forbidden("Run tidak dikenal")
    results = await ctx.services.agent_api.query_context(
        ctx.run_id,
        inp.query,
        scope=inp.scope,
        task_id=str(run.task_id) if inp.scope == "task" and run.task_id else None,
        top_k=inp.top_k,
        base_url=(run.callback or {}).get("agent_api_base_url"),
    )
    hits = [ContextHit(**r) for r in results]
    return ContextQueryOut(summary=f"{len(hits)} blok konteks untuk '{inp.query or 'project brief'}'",
                           results=hits)

from mcp_marketing.services.agent.profiles import get_active_profile
from mcp_marketing.services.agent.runs import RunInput, RunRegistry

log = get_logger(__name__)


def _check_version(inp: ContractInput) -> None:
    if not is_supported_contract(inp.contract_version):
        raise UnsupportedContractVersion(
            f"contract_version {inp.contract_version!r} tidak didukung (MCP mendukung 1.x)", retryable=False
        )


async def _profile(ctx: ToolContext, agent_key: str) -> AgentProfile:
    async with ctx.services.db.session() as session:
        profile = await get_active_profile(session, agent_key)
    if profile is None:
        raise UnknownAgent(f"agent_key '{agent_key}' tidak dikenal/aktif di MCP", retryable=False)
    return profile


async def _start_run(trigger: str, inp: RunInput, ctx: ToolContext) -> DispatchOutput:
    _check_version(inp)
    profile = await _profile(ctx, inp.agent_key)
    registry = RunRegistry(ctx.services.db)
    accepted = await registry.accept(trigger, inp, profile)
    if accepted.created:
        outbox = ctx.services.outbox
        if outbox is not None:
            # event pertama (seq 1) dicatat SEBELUM membalas Dashboard
            await outbox.emit(accepted.run_id, "agent.task.started", {})
        if ctx.services.runtime is not None:
            ctx.services.runtime.start(accepted.run_id)
    return DispatchOutput(accepted=True, mcp_run_id=accepted.mcp_run_id)

    name="pm_dispatch_task_to_agent",

    summary="Dashboard: tugaskan task ke agent (async)",

    "the background. Idempotent per run_id.",
    input_model=DispatchInput,
    output_model=DispatchOutput,
    writes=True,
    timeout_s=14,
)
async def pm_dispatch_task_to_agent(inp: DispatchInput, ctx: ToolContext) -> DispatchOutput:
    return await _start_run("assignment", inp, ctx)

    input_model=EstimationInput,
    output_model=EstimationOutput,

)
async def pm_request_agent_estimation(inp: EstimationInput, ctx: ToolContext) -> EstimationOutput:
    _check_version(inp)
    await _profile(ctx, inp.agent_key)
    output, tokens = await estimation.estimate(inp, ctx.services.llm, budget=ctx.budget)
    ctx.llm_tokens += tokens
    return output

    "Idempotent; unknown runs also return cancelled=true.",
    input_model=CancelInput,
    output_model=CancelOutput,
    writes=True,
    timeout_s=5,
)
async def pm_cancel_agent_run(inp: CancelInput, ctx: ToolContext) -> CancelOutput:
    _check_version(inp)
    known = await RunRegistry(ctx.services.db).mark_cancelled(inp.run_id, inp.reason)
    if known:
        if ctx.services.runtime is not None:
            ctx.services.runtime.cancel(inp.run_id)
        if ctx.services.jobs is not None:

        if ctx.services.outbox is not None:
            await ctx.services.outbox.discard_run(inp.run_id, reason=f"cancel:{inp.reason}")
    log.info("run.cancel", run_id=inp.run_id, known=known, reason=inp.reason)
    return CancelOutput(cancelled=True)

    "Empty query returns the Project Brief. Text is truncated to 600 chars per result.",
    input_model=ContextQueryIn,
    output_model=ContextQueryOut,
    agent_only=True,
)

        top_k=inp.top_k,

                           results=hits)

"""Riwayat percakapan agent: persistensi `run_steps` (untuk resume) + kompaksi riwayat.

Baris `run_steps`: `step` = nomor urut baris per run; `role` = assistant | tool | summary | user.
Kompaksi: pesan di antara brief dan 2 langkah terakhir diganti ringkasan `fast` (≤ 300 token)
yang mempertahankan handle/job/report id (MCP_SPEC §8, TASK-10).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import uuid
from typing import Any

import orjson
from sqlalchemy import func, select

from mcp_marketing.core.database import Database
from mcp_marketing.core.logging import get_logger
from mcp_marketing.models import RunStep
from mcp_marketing.services.llm import prompts
from mcp_marketing.utils.text import truncate
from mcp_marketing.utils.tokens import count_tokens

log = get_logger(__name__)

SUMMARY_MAX_TOKENS = 300
KEEP_TAIL_STEPS = 2
HISTORY_LINE_MAX = 1_500
_ID_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:h|j|r|mr)_[0-9a-z]{10}\b")


class RunMemory:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, run_id: str) -> None:
        self.db = db
        self.run_id = run_id
        self._next_step: int | None = None

    async def _step_no(self) -> int:
        if self._next_step is None:
            async with self.db.session() as session:
                last = await session.scalar(
                    select(func.max(RunStep.step)).where(RunStep.run_id == uuid.UUID(self.run_id))
                )
            self._next_step = int(last or 0) + 1
        step = self._next_step
        self._next_step += 1
        return step

    async def save(self, role: str, content: dict[str, Any], *, tool: str | None = None, tokens: int = 0) -> None:
        step = await self._step_no()
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            session.add(RunStep(run_id=uuid.UUID(self.run_id), step=step, role=role, tool=tool,
                                content=orjson.loads(orjson.dumps(content, default=str)), tokens=tokens))

    async def load(self) -> list[RunStep]:
        async with self.db.session() as session:
            rows = await session.scalars(
                select(RunStep).where(RunStep.run_id == uuid.UUID(self.run_id)).order_by(RunStep.step)
            )
            return list(rows.all())


def messages_from_steps(head: list[dict[str, Any]], steps: list[RunStep]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Rekonstruksi pesan untuk resume. Ringkasan menggantikan semua langkah sebelumnya."""
    body: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in steps:
        if row.role == "summary":
            body = [summary_message(str(row.content.get("text", "")))]
            body += [m for m in row.content.get("tail", [])]
        elif row.role == "assistant":
            body.append(_assistant_message(row.content))
        elif row.role == "tool":
            body.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": row.content.get("tool_call_id"),
                         "content": row.content.get("content", "")})
        elif row.role == "user":
            body.append({"role": "user", "content": row.content.get("content", "")})
    return head + _drop_dangling(body)


def _assistant_message(content: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    msg: dict[str, Any] = {"role": "assistant", "content": content.get("content")}
    calls = content.get("tool_calls") or []
    if calls:
        msg["tool_calls"] = [
            {"id": c["id"], "type": "function",
             "function": {"name": c["name"], "arguments": orjson.dumps(c.get("arguments") or {}).decode()}}
            for c in calls
        ]
    return msg


def _drop_dangling(body: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Buang assistant terakhir yang tool_call-nya belum punya hasil (crash di tengah eksekusi)."""
    answered = {m.get("tool_call_id") for m in body if m.get("role") == "tool"}
    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for msg in body:
        calls = msg.get("tool_calls") or []
        if msg.get("role") == "assistant" and calls and not all(c["id"] in answered for c in calls):
            break
        out.append(msg)
    return out


def summary_message(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"role": "user", "content": f"[Ringkasan langkah sebelumnya]\n{text}"}


def split_for_compaction(messages: list[dict[str, Any]], head_len: int,
                         keep_steps: int = KEEP_TAIL_STEPS) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Pisah `(tengah, ekor)`: ekor dimulai pada pesan assistant ke-`keep_steps` dari belakang."""
    body = messages[head_len:]
    starts = [i for i, m in enumerate(body) if m.get("role") == "assistant"]
    if len(starts) <= keep_steps:
        return [], body
    cut = starts[-keep_steps]
    return body[:cut], body[cut:]


def history_text(middle: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    lines = []
    for m in middle:
        role = m.get("role")
        if role == "assistant":
            calls = ", ".join(
                f"{c['function']['name']}({truncate(c['function']['arguments'], 200)})" for c in m.get("tool_calls") or []
            )
            text = m.get("content") or ""
            lines.append(f"ASSISTANT: {truncate(text, 400)} {('-> ' + calls) if calls else ''}".strip())
        elif role == "tool":
            lines.append(f"TOOL: {truncate(str(m.get('content', '')), HISTORY_LINE_MAX)}")
        else:
            lines.append(f"{str(role).upper()}: {truncate(str(m.get('content', '')), HISTORY_LINE_MAX)}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


async def compact_history(llm: Any, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], head_len: int, *,
                          budget: Any = None) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], str | None, int]:
    """Kembalikan `(pesan_baru, teks_ringkasan, token_dipakai)`; tanpa perubahan bila tak ada bagian tengah."""
    middle, tail = split_for_compaction(messages, head_len)
    if not middle:
        return messages, None, 0
    history = history_text(middle)
    ids = sorted(set(_ID_RE.findall(history)))
    prompt = prompts.render("compact_history", max_tokens=SUMMARY_MAX_TOKENS, history=history)
    result = await llm.chat("compact", [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}], max_tokens=SUMMARY_MAX_TOKENS,
                            budget=budget, prompt_version="v1")
    summary = (result.content or "").strip()
    missing = [i for i in ids if i not in summary]
    if missing:
        summary += "\nID relevan: " + ", ".join(missing)
    new_messages = messages[:head_len] + [summary_message(summary)] + tail
    log.info("agent.history_compacted", before=count_tokens(messages), after=count_tokens(new_messages))
    return new_messages, summary, result.total_tokens

        elif row.role == "assistant":
            body.append(_assistant_message(row.content))
        elif row.role == "tool":
            body.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": row.content.get("tool_call_id"),
                         "content": row.content.get("content", "")})
        elif row.role == "user":
            body.append({"role": "user", "content": row.content.get("content", "")})
    return head + _drop_dangling(body)


def _assistant_message(content: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    msg: dict[str, Any] = {"role": "assistant", "content": content.get("content")}
    calls = content.get("tool_calls") or []
    if calls:
        msg["tool_calls"] = [
            {"id": c["id"], "type": "function",
             "function": {"name": c["name"], "arguments": orjson.dumps(c.get("arguments") or {}).decode()}}
            for c in calls
        ]
    return msg


def _drop_dangling(body: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Buang assistant terakhir yang tool_call-nya belum punya hasil (crash di tengah eksekusi)."""
    answered = {m.get("tool_call_id") for m in body if m.get("role") == "tool"}
    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for msg in body:
        calls = msg.get("tool_calls") or []
        if msg.get("role") == "assistant" and calls and not all(c["id"] in answered for c in calls):
            break
        out.append(msg)
    return out


def summary_message(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"role": "user", "content": f"[Ringkasan langkah sebelumnya]\n{text}"}


def split_for_compaction(messages: list[dict[str, Any]], head_len: int,
                         keep_steps: int = KEEP_TAIL_STEPS) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Pisah `(tengah, ekor)`: ekor dimulai pada pesan assistant ke-`keep_steps` dari belakang."""
    body = messages[head_len:]
    starts = [i for i, m in enumerate(body) if m.get("role") == "assistant"]
    if len(starts) <= keep_steps:
        return [], body
    cut = starts[-keep_steps]
    return body[:cut], body[cut:]


def history_text(middle: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    lines = []
    for m in middle:
        role = m.get("role")
        if role == "assistant":
            calls = ", ".join(
                f"{c['function']['name']}({truncate(c['function']['arguments'], 200)})" for c in m.get("tool_calls") or []
            )
            text = m.get("content") or ""
            lines.append(f"ASSISTANT: {truncate(text, 400)} {('-> ' + calls) if calls else ''}".strip())
        elif role == "tool":
            lines.append(f"TOOL: {truncate(str(m.get('content', '')), HISTORY_LINE_MAX)}")
        else:
            lines.append(f"{str(role).upper()}: {truncate(str(m.get('content', '')), HISTORY_LINE_MAX)}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


async def compact_history(llm: Any, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], head_len: int, *,
                          budget: Any = None) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], str | None, int]:
    """Kembalikan `(pesan_baru, teks_ringkasan, token_dipakai)`; tanpa perubahan bila tak ada bagian tengah."""
    middle, tail = split_for_compaction(messages, head_len)
    if not middle:
        return messages, None, 0
    history = history_text(middle)
    ids = sorted(set(_ID_RE.findall(history)))
    prompt = prompts.render("compact_history", max_tokens=SUMMARY_MAX_TOKENS, history=history)
    result = await llm.chat("compact", [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}], max_tokens=SUMMARY_MAX_TOKENS,
                            budget=budget, prompt_version="v1")
    summary = (result.content or "").strip()
    missing = [i for i in ids if i not in summary]
    if missing:
        summary += "\nID relevan: " + ", ".join(missing)
    new_messages = messages[:head_len] + [summary_message(summary)] + tail
    log.info("agent.history_compacted", before=count_tokens(messages), after=count_tokens(new_messages))
    return new_messages, summary, result.total_tokens

"""Tool virtual agent runtime: menulis ke Dashboard lewat webhook (run_id disuntik runtime, bukan LLM).

Aturan keamanan kontrak: hanya task run atau turunannya; tidak bisa mengubah assignee, menghapus,
atau menyentuh project lain; mention agent tidak disertakan (pencegahan loop).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from mcp_marketing.core.errors import (
    Forbidden,
    HierarchyDepthExceeded,
    RunNotActive,
    UpstreamTimeout,
    ValidationFailed,
)
from mcp_marketing.schemas.common import ToolInput
from mcp_marketing.schemas.contract import MAX_DEPTH, TaskPriority
from mcp_marketing.server.auth import ClientIdentity
from mcp_marketing.server.registry import ToolSpec, compact_schema
from mcp_marketing.services.dashboard.chunking import chain_append_ops, chunk_block_ops, chunk_subtasks
from mcp_marketing.services.dashboard.outbox import Outbox
from mcp_marketing.services.templates.md_to_blocks import markdown_to_blocks
from mcp_marketing.utils.text import truncate

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from mcp_marketing.models import AgentProfile

UUID_RE = r"^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$"
DATE_RE = r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$"
COMMENT_SUMMARY_MAX = 1_500


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ input model
class ReportProgressIn(ToolInput):
    status: Literal["thinking", "working"] = "working"
    message: str = Field(max_length=120)


class BlockUpdate(BaseModel):
    block_id: str = Field(pattern=UUID_RE)
    markdown: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=10_000)
    expected_version: int | None = Field(default=None, gt=0)


class WriteBlocksIn(ToolInput):
    markdown: str = Field(default="", max_length=40_000, description="Markdown ringkas yang ditambahkan")
    task_id: str | None = Field(default=None, pattern=UUID_RE, description="Default: task run")
    after_block_id: str | None = Field(default=None, pattern=UUID_RE, description="Sisip setelah blok ini")
    updates: list[BlockUpdate] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=50,
                                       description="Ganti isi blok yang ada (blok pertama markdown)")


class NewSubtask(BaseModel):
    client_ref: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=100)
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)
    priority: TaskPriority | None = None
    start_date: str | None = Field(default=None, pattern=DATE_RE)
    end_date: str | None = Field(default=None, pattern=DATE_RE)
    tags: list[str] | None = Field(default=None, max_length=20)
    assign_to_self: bool = False
    markdown: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=8_000, description="Isi awal dokumen subtask")


class CreateSubtasksIn(ToolInput):
    parent_task_id: str | None = Field(default=None, pattern=UUID_RE, description="Default: task run")
    subtasks: list[NewSubtask] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=60)


class PostCommentIn(ToolInput):
    content: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=10_000)
    parent_comment_id: str | None = Field(default=None, pattern=UUID_RE)
    mention_user_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)


class FinishIn(ToolInput):
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)


class FailIn(ToolInput):
    error_code: str = Field(pattern=r"^[A-Z][A-Z_]{2,63}$")
    message: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)
    retryable: bool = False


class _Out(BaseModel):
    summary: str


async def _unused(inp: Any, ctx: Any) -> Any:  # pragma: no cover - dieksekusi runtime, bukan pipeline
    raise NotImplementedError


def _spec(name: str, summary: str, description: str, model: type[BaseModel]) -> ToolSpec:
    return ToolSpec(name=name, toolset="runtime", summary=summary, description=description,
                    input_model=model, output_model=_Out, handler=_unused, writes=True)


VIRTUAL_TOOLS: dict[str, ToolSpec] = {
    s.name: s
    for s in (
        _spec("report_progress", "Kirim status singkat ke Dashboard",
              "Show a short progress status on the Dashboard task badge (thinking|working, <=120 chars).",
              ReportProgressIn),
        _spec("write_blocks", "Tulis markdown ke dokumen task",
              "Append concise markdown (headings, bullets, checklists, tables) to the task document, or "
              "replace existing blocks via updates. Default target is the run task.", WriteBlocksIn),
        _spec("create_subtasks", "Buat subtask di bawah task run",
              "Create subtasks under the run task (or a subtask created in this run). Give each a "
              "client_ref; returns client_ref->id mapping. Max depth 3.", CreateSubtasksIn),
        _spec("post_comment", "Kirim komentar sebagai agent",
              "Post a comment as the agent on the run task (mention runs reply in the same thread).",
              PostCommentIn),
        _spec("finish", "Selesaikan run dengan ringkasan",
              "Finish the run successfully with a summary (<=500 chars). Call exactly once at the end.",
              FinishIn),
        _spec("fail", "Gagalkan run dengan kode error",
              "Stop the run as failed with an UPPER_SNAKE error_code and a short message.", FailIn),
    )
}
WRITE_VIRTUALS = frozenset(VIRTUAL_TOOLS)


def openai_tool(spec: ToolSpec) -> dict[str, Any]:
    params = compact_schema(spec.input_model.model_json_schema())
    return {"type": "function", "function": {"name": spec.name, "description": spec.description,
                                             "parameters": params}}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ state
@dataclass
class RunState:
    run_id: str
    trigger: str
    agent_key: str
    task_id: str | None
    project_id: str
    run_input: dict[str, Any]
    profile: AgentProfile
    identity: ClientIdentity
    allowed: dict[str, ToolSpec]
    max_steps: int
    route: str
    subtask_refs: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    known_tasks: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)  # task_id -> depth
    last_block: dict[str | None, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    finished: str | None = None
    failed: tuple[str, str, bool] | None = None
    comment_posted: bool = False
    working_sent: bool = False

    @property
    def prompt_block_id(self) -> str | None:
        return (self.run_input.get("prompt_block") or {}).get("id") if self.trigger == "prompt_block" else None

    @property
    def mention_parent(self) -> str | None:
        comment = self.run_input.get("comment") or {}
        return comment.get("parent_comment_id") or comment.get("id") if self.trigger == "mention" else None


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ eksekusi
class VirtualTools:
    def __init__(self, outbox: Outbox, persist_refs: Any) -> None:
        self.outbox = outbox
        self._persist_refs = persist_refs

    async def execute(self, state: RunState, name: str, args: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        model = VIRTUAL_TOOLS[name].input_model
        inp = model.model_validate(args)
        handler = getattr(self, f"_{name}")
        result: dict[str, Any] = await handler(state, inp)
        return result

    async def _report_progress(self, state: RunState, inp: ReportProgressIn) -> dict[str, Any]:
        await self.outbox.emit(state.run_id, "agent.status.changed", {"status": inp.status, "message": inp.message})
        state.working_sent = state.working_sent or inp.status == "working"
        return {"summary": "status dikirim"}

    def _check_task(self, state: RunState, task_id: str | None) -> str | None:
        if task_id is None:
            return state.task_id
        task_id = task_id.lower()
        if task_id not in state.known_tasks:
            raise Forbidden("task_id di luar cakupan run ini (hanya task run & turunannya)")
        return task_id

    async def _write_blocks(self, state: RunState, inp: WriteBlocksIn) -> dict[str, Any]:
        target = self._check_task(state, inp.task_id)
        blocks = markdown_to_blocks(inp.markdown) if inp.markdown.strip() else []
        if not blocks and not inp.updates:
            raise ValidationFailed("markdown kosong dan tidak ada updates")
        after = inp.after_block_id or state.last_block.get(target)
        if after is None and target == state.task_id and state.prompt_block_id:
            after = state.prompt_block_id
        ops = chain_append_ops(blocks, after_block_id=after) if after else chain_append_ops(blocks, after_block_id=None)
        for upd in inp.updates:
            converted = markdown_to_blocks(upd.markdown)
            if not converted:
                raise ValidationFailed(f"markdown update kosong untuk blok {upd.block_id}")
            op: dict[str, Any] = {"op": "update", "block": {"id": upd.block_id, **converted[0]}}
            if upd.expected_version:
                op["expected_version"] = upd.expected_version
            ops.append(op)
        applied: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        conflicts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        pending = False
        for chunk in chunk_block_ops(ops):
            try:
                res = await self.outbox.emit_and_wait(state.run_id, "agent.block.appended", {"operations": chunk},
                                                      task_id=target)
            except UpstreamTimeout:
                pending = True
                continue
            applied += res.get("applied") or []
            conflicts += res.get("conflicts") or []
        appended = [o for o in ops if o["op"] == "append"]
        if appended and after is not None:
            state.last_block[target] = appended[-1]["block"]["id"]
        out: dict[str, Any] = {"summary": f"{len(applied) or len(ops)} blok ditulis", "applied": len(applied)}
        if conflicts:
            out["conflicts"] = conflicts[:20]
        if pending:
            out["pending"] = True
        return out

    async def _create_subtasks(self, state: RunState, inp: CreateSubtasksIn) -> dict[str, Any]:
        parent = self._check_task(state, inp.parent_task_id)
        if parent is None:
            raise Forbidden("Subtask hanya dapat dibuat pada run task")
        parent_depth = state.known_tasks.get(parent, 1)
        if parent_depth + 1 > MAX_DEPTH:
            raise HierarchyDepthExceeded(f"Kedalaman subtask maksimal {MAX_DEPTH}")
        specs = []
        for i, s in enumerate(inp.subtasks):
            spec: dict[str, Any] = {
                "client_ref": s.client_ref or f"s{len(state.subtask_refs) + i + 1}",
                "title": s.title,
                "assign_to_self": s.assign_to_self,
            }
            for key in ("priority", "start_date", "end_date", "tags"):
                if getattr(s, key) is not None:
                    spec[key] = getattr(s, key)
            if s.markdown:
                spec["initial_blocks"] = markdown_to_blocks(s.markdown)[:50]
            specs.append(spec)
        created: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for chunk in chunk_subtasks(specs):
            data: dict[str, Any] = {"subtasks": chunk}
            if parent != state.task_id:
                data["parent_task_id"] = parent
            res = await self.outbox.emit_and_wait(state.run_id, "agent.subtask.created", data)
            created += res.get("created") or []
        for c in created:
            if c.get("id"):
                state.known_tasks[str(c["id"]).lower()] = parent_depth + 1
                if c.get("client_ref"):
                    state.subtask_refs[str(c["client_ref"])] = str(c["id"])
        await self._persist_refs(state.run_id, state.subtask_refs)
        return {"summary": f"{len(created)} subtask dibuat",
                "created": [{"client_ref": c.get("client_ref"), "id": c.get("id")} for c in created]}

    async def _post_comment(self, state: RunState, inp: PostCommentIn) -> dict[str, Any]:
        data: dict[str, Any] = {"content": inp.content}
        parent = inp.parent_comment_id or state.mention_parent
        if parent:
            data["parent_comment_id"] = parent
        users = [u for u in inp.mention_user_ids if _is_uuid(u)]
        if users:
            data["mentions"] = [{"type": "user", "id": u} for u in users]
        res = await self.outbox.emit_and_wait(state.run_id, "agent.comment.added", data)
        state.comment_posted = True
        return {"summary": "komentar terkirim", "comment_id": res.get("comment_id")}

    async def _finish(self, state: RunState, inp: FinishIn) -> dict[str, Any]:
        state.finished = inp.summary
        return {"summary": "run akan diselesaikan"}

    async def _fail(self, state: RunState, inp: FailIn) -> dict[str, Any]:
        state.failed = (inp.error_code, inp.message, inp.retryable)
        return {"summary": "run akan digagalkan"}


def _is_uuid(value: str) -> bool:
    try:
        uuid.UUID(value)
        return True
    except ValueError:
        return False


def completion_comment(summary: str) -> str:
    return truncate(f"Selesai. {summary}", COMMENT_SUMMARY_MAX)


__all__ = ["RunNotActive", "VIRTUAL_TOOLS", "VirtualTools", "RunState"]
